a91337d4c9eda291a91f8ca3f4e2002ebe214990.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b17c339682feb692aea8cf4fb0ce98c3add694e9.english: A child phones his grandparents every week in their family language. His grandmother tells him about the games she played as a child and explains the words he doesn’t understand.
b17c339682feb692aea8cf4fb0ce98c3add694e9.french: Un enfant téléphone chaque semaine à ses grands-parents dans leur langue familiale. Sa grand-mère lui raconte ses jeux d'enfance et lui explique les mots qu'il ne comprend pas.

b6c3d663c1b8f8c38d983215a9db7ffec891266b.english: If parents are more comfortable in their mother tongue, giving it up may limit conversations. They can tell a story, offer advice or understand what is troubling their child without constantly having to search for the right words.
b6c3d663c1b8f8c38d983215a9db7ffec891266b.french: Si les parents sont plus à l'aise dans leur langue maternelle, l'abandonner peut limiter les conversations. Ils peuvent raconter une histoire, donner un conseil ou comprendre ce qui préoccupe l'enfant sans chercher sans cesse leurs mots.

bd05253b29f6883168b8c4951948b4245e30f3ee.english: Finally, the child must also be able to practise the country's language.
bd05253b29f6883168b8c4951948b4245e30f3ee.french: Enfin, il faut que l'enfant puisse aussi pratiquer la langue du pays.
bd05253b29f6883168b8c4951948b4245e30f3ee.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

bd90413b3ade6cf5d0373500fee3ed86593f2d5a.english: I wouldn’t choose one language over the other. I would make room for the mother tongue in family interactions, whilst helping the children to learn the language of the host country.
bd90413b3ade6cf5d0373500fee3ed86593f2d5a.french: Je ne choisirais pas une langue contre l'autre. Je garderais une place pour la langue maternelle dans les échanges en famille, tout en aidant les enfants à apprendre celle du pays d'accueil.

c12e962a27c8468e2b7a6e7471db094df6fbecc7.english: During a call, a grandmother shows an old photograph and explains where it was taken. Her grandson understands her language and asks his own questions without waiting for his mother.
c12e962a27c8468e2b7a6e7471db094df6fbecc7.french: Pendant un appel, une grand-mère montre une ancienne photo et raconte où elle a été prise. Son petit-fils comprend sa langue et pose ses propres questions sans attendre sa mère.
c12e962a27c8468e2b7a6e7471db094df6fbecc7.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

cda5b47e5693804a1e7f2f5ecedb7ab5f000c2bd.english: He builds his relationship with her and discovers part of his family history.
cda5b47e5693804a1e7f2f5ecedb7ab5f000c2bd.french: Il construit sa relation avec elle et découvre une partie de son histoire familiale.
cda5b47e5693804a1e7f2f5ecedb7ab5f000c2bd.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d27c659fb4fdb7f357a6388f04fb89dbdfea5bd6.english: Furthermore, the family language can help maintain relationships between generations.
d27c659fb4fdb7f357a6388f04fb89dbdfea5bd6.french: Ensuite, la langue familiale peut entretenir des relations entre générations.

d99f8b51b23eaf70e4943e1a067ca00b7947ea8a.english: However, there is no need to speak one language exclusively at home and the other at school. Perfect bilingualism is not guaranteed. The important thing is to encourage the child to speak, without making them feel embarrassed when they are searching for a word.
d99f8b51b23eaf70e4943e1a067ca00b7947ea8a.french: Cependant, on n'est pas obligé de parler une langue uniquement à la maison et l'autre à l'école. Le bilinguisme parfait n'est pas garanti. L'important est d'encourager l'enfant à parler, sans lui faire honte quand il cherche un mot.

e7cefbba58776fc2b81974cc26e8b13c00c0a490.english: Finally, practising the local language helps the child to participate in the life of the country.
e7cefbba58776fc2b81974cc26e8b13c00c0a490.french: Enfin, pratiquer la langue locale aide l'enfant à participer à la vie du pays.

eb90c3885466e1abc1e3aeddd04a35c95b3a0c5f.english: First, the parents' language allows direct communication with family living elsewhere.
eb90c3885466e1abc1e3aeddd04a35c95b3a0c5f.french: D'abord, la langue des parents permet de communiquer directement avec la famille restée ailleurs.
eb90c3885466e1abc1e3aeddd04a35c95b3a0c5f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

03fff20f8097502e66eea75cc51cef21c36c0e41.english: Furthermore, taking part helps people learn useful skills for living independently.
03fff20f8097502e66eea75cc51cef21c36c0e41.french: Ensuite, participer permet d'apprendre des gestes utiles pour vivre de manière autonome.

0734632de0a0033c7b52d0b4336f2558557271b6.english: First and foremost, sharing tasks prevents one person from having to do all the work for everyone else.
0734632de0a0033c7b52d0b4336f2558557271b6.french: Tout d'abord, partager les tâches évite qu'une seule personne se fatigue pour tout le monde.

09bb6b5bc7943c54abed20c57a953c21a64c90e2.english: When no one knows who is responsible for a particular task, everyone may assume that someone else will do it. Allocating responsibilities – including checking what is missing – means people can take action without having to wait for reminders from a single person.
09bb6b5bc7943c54abed20c57a953c21a64c90e2.french: Quand personne ne sait qui s'occupe d'une tâche, chacun peut croire que l'autre va la faire. Répartir les responsabilités, y compris vérifier ce qui manque, permet d'agir sans attendre les rappels d'une seule personne.

10faa9dc699f2b914fec1d28fe03ba9636496def.english: Next, contributing teaches children to look after themselves.
10faa9dc699f2b914fec1d28fe03ba9636496def.french: Ensuite, participer apprend aux enfants à s'occuper d'eux-mêmes.
10faa9dc699f2b914fec1d28fe03ba9636496def.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

11fdde4853efc33a815a6129ac3e83d062fe64a9.english: Finally, a clear system of organisation prevents things from being overlooked and avoids arguments about what each person is supposed to do.
11fdde4853efc33a815a6129ac3e83d062fe64a9.french: Enfin, une organisation claire évite les oublis et les disputes sur ce que chacun doit faire.

39d549f9ce487635c80a3b5e4e9eedb49f9483fc.english: Yes, every member of the household should contribute to chores according to their abilities. Sharing prevents one person spending all their time on others and teaches children to manage for themselves. Organisation must also be shared, not just the visible tasks.
39d549f9ce487635c80a3b5e4e9eedb49f9483fc.french: Oui, chaque membre du foyer devrait participer aux tâches selon ses possibilités. Ce partage évite qu'une personne consacre tout son temps aux autres et apprend aux enfants à se débrouiller. Il faut aussi répartir l'organisation, pas seulement les gestes visibles.
39d549f9ce487635c80a3b5e4e9eedb49f9483fc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

3a9623c78c4222f67dc3f04468fb8a67943cef1d.english: First, sharing chores is a matter of fairness.
3a9623c78c4222f67dc3f04468fb8a67943cef1d.french: D'abord, partager les tâches est une question de justice.
3a9623c78c4222f67dc3f04468fb8a67943cef1d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.english: Both keep some free time: one person's rest no longer depends on the other's work.
45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.french: Les deux gardent du temps libre : le repos de l'un ne dépend plus du travail de l'autre.
45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

49bb22939b748ddf20b59144179a7b58d6a045d3.english: Sharing the workload can therefore give everyone time to rest.
49bb22939b748ddf20b59144179a7b58d6a045d3.french: Le partage peut ainsi laisser à chacun du temps pour se reposer.

52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.english: Everyone benefits from meals and clean laundry. If one person takes care of it all, the others rest while that person works. Contributing is therefore not doing them a favour, but taking your share of responsibility for living together.
52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.french: Tout le monde profite des repas et du linge propre. Si une seule personne s'en occupe, les autres se reposent pendant qu'elle travaille. Participer n'est donc pas lui rendre service, mais assumer sa part de la vie commune.
52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.english: You do not know how to manage a home simply because you reach a certain age. You need to learn to cook, wash clothes and put away the equipment you have used. Parents demonstrate, then let children try with appropriate responsibilities.
53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.french: On ne sait pas gérer un logement simplement parce qu'on atteint un certain âge. Il faut apprendre à cuisiner, laver le linge et ranger le matériel utilisé. Les parents montrent les gestes, puis laissent essayer avec des responsabilités adaptées.
53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

572622dfd97780f2be0f514966c752c9f70e2bef.english: A teenager can learn to sort the laundry and select the wash cycle with an adult. After several supervised attempts, they can take charge of a wash, rather than only discovering how to use the machine on the day they leave home.
572622dfd97780f2be0f514966c752c9f70e2bef.french: Un adolescent peut apprendre à trier le linge et à choisir le programme de lavage avec un adulte. Après plusieurs essais accompagnés, il peut prendre en charge une lessive, plutôt que découvrir la machine seulement le jour où il quitte le domicile familial.

594cb6700eab8b98f52382baf0cf87d2fa90ccb1.english: In a couple, one person takes charge of household cleaning products. They check the stock and buy more before they run out. The other person can then do the washing without having to stop what they’re doing to go to the shop.
594cb6700eab8b98f52382baf0cf87d2fa90ccb1.french: Dans un couple, l'un s'occupe des produits d'entretien. Il vérifie le stock et les achète avant qu'ils manquent. L'autre peut alors laver le linge sans interrompre son travail pour aller au magasin.

8b05277cc9edc69c0cd308d6ef8a0aacfb1001cb.english: In a couple where both partners work, one prepares dinner while the other lays the table and tidies the kitchen afterwards. Neither spends the whole evening managing the meal alone.
8b05277cc9edc69c0cd308d6ef8a0aacfb1001cb.french: Dans un couple où les deux travaillent, l'un prépare le dîner pendant que l'autre met la table et range ensuite la cuisine. Personne ne passe toute la soirée à gérer seul le repas.
8b05277cc9edc69c0cd308d6ef8a0aacfb1001cb.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

93b463d03d6c5768985c9046a3a417632831d70f.english: Everyone benefits from a meal, clean clothes or a tidy room. If just one person consistently carries out the tasks, they are using up their own rest time so that others can rest.
93b463d03d6c5768985c9046a3a417632831d70f.french: Tout le monde profite d'un repas, de vêtements propres ou d'une pièce rangée. Si une seule personne réalise systématiquement les tâches, elle prend sur son temps de repos pour que les autres puissent se reposer.

984ada63365e1e21c5491ac2090955a9e045ad4e.english: This does not mean everyone doing exactly the same thing. A child can put away their toys; an adult who is ill can be excused from certain chores. People can also help one another during a busy period. Fairness takes abilities and available time into account.
984ada63365e1e21c5491ac2090955a9e045ad4e.french: Cela ne veut pas dire faire tous exactement la même chose. Un enfant peut ranger ses jouets ; un adulte malade peut être dispensé de certaines tâches. On peut aussi s'entraider pendant une période chargée. L'équité tient compte des capacités et du temps disponible.
984ada63365e1e21c5491ac2090955a9e045ad4e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9a0c091e38b3206571d77a157395916abf105fc8.english: Two parents come home from work at around six o’clock. Whilst one prepares dinner, the other sets the table and then does the washing-up after the meal. Once the kitchen is tidied up, they both have a moment to rest.
9a0c091e38b3206571d77a157395916abf105fc8.french: Deux parents rentrent du travail vers dix-huit heures. Pendant que l'un prépare le dîner, l'autre met la table, puis fait la vaisselle après le repas. Une fois la cuisine rangée, ils ont tous les deux un moment pour se reposer.

9e5405f5c003d84dcf093693bf7ccccce2b714c8.english: In conclusion, everyone should contribute according to their abilities, without having to do exactly the same thing. Sharing the work, learning useful skills and planning tasks together prevents one person from having to do everything on their own.
9e5405f5c003d84dcf093693bf7ccccce2b714c8.french: En conclusion, chacun devrait contribuer selon ses possibilités, sans devoir faire exactement la même chose. Partager le travail, apprendre les gestes utiles et prévoir les tâches ensemble évite qu'une seule personne s'occupe de tout.

b33edcb68d2d60d37422cc1c6680b1bac654b14d.english: You do not automatically know how to look after a home just because you have become an adult. Tasks that are suitable and clearly explained provide an opportunity to practise, and then gradually take on more responsibility.
b33edcb68d2d60d37422cc1c6680b1bac654b14d.french: On ne maîtrise pas automatiquement l'entretien d'un logement en devenant adulte. Des tâches adaptées et expliquées donnent l'occasion de s'entraîner, puis de prendre progressivement une responsabilité.

c3137bd064e2b9edbe487e074e5075e010a35afe.english: Finally, a task is still poorly shared if the same person always has to think about it.
c3137bd064e2b9edbe487e074e5075e010a35afe.french: Enfin, une tâche reste mal partagée si la même personne doit toujours y penser.
c3137bd064e2b9edbe487e074e5075e010a35afe.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c87f6d80d1cf0bc9c0064ed26fac2dd2e40eb07e.english: He gains a practical skill that will be useful when he leaves home.
c87f6d80d1cf0bc9c0064ed26fac2dd2e40eb07e.french: Il acquiert une compétence concrète qui lui servira lorsqu'il quittera le foyer.
c87f6d80d1cf0bc9c0064ed26fac2dd2e40eb07e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

dd4e473abc2e1f6eab3347cde57ad5c75db1d16e.english: Noticing what is missing, planning when to act and checking the result also take work. If someone gives every instruction, they remain responsible for the whole thing. Everyone therefore needs to manage their task from start to finish.
dd4e473abc2e1f6eab3347cde57ad5c75db1d16e.french: Remarquer ce qui manque, prévoir quand agir et vérifier le résultat demandent aussi du travail. Si quelqu'un distribue chaque consigne, il reste responsable de l'ensemble. Il faut donc que chacun gère sa tâche jusqu'au bout.
dd4e473abc2e1f6eab3347cde57ad5c75db1d16e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e66adbea9902df82a562cb0908fa9dbe15542808.english: However, illness, a disability or a particularly difficult period may justify a reduced contribution, or even no tasks at all. One should not have to perform a service in order to be recognised as a member of the household. A fair system adapts to actual abilities and can be reviewed.
e66adbea9902df82a562cb0908fa9dbe15542808.french: Cependant, la maladie, le handicap ou une période particulièrement difficile peuvent justifier une participation réduite, voire aucune tâche. Il ne faut pas exiger un service pour reconnaître la place d'une personne dans le foyer. Une organisation juste s'ajuste aux capacités réelles et peut être revue.

e9b617a960ca64be907bfb82a60dd3546402dfb9.english: Taking full responsibility reduces the organisational burden, not just the number of actions.
e9b617a960ca64be907bfb82a60dd3546402dfb9.french: Une responsabilité entière allège la charge d'organisation, pas seulement le nombre de gestes.
e9b617a960ca64be907bfb82a60dd3546402dfb9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eaba921068fad0a239d4a7c977703de94414e26e.english: A teenager learns to sort his laundry and run a washing machine with a parent. Afterwards, he regularly takes care of his clothes without waiting for someone to do it for him.
eaba921068fad0a239d4a7c977703de94414e26e.french: Un adolescent apprend à trier son linge et à lancer une machine avec un parent. Ensuite, il s'occupe régulièrement de ses vêtements sans attendre que quelqu'un le fasse pour lui.
eaba921068fad0a239d4a7c977703de94414e26e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f123e6ae6e9e69841684e8c63bff4aa667cc5064.english: Everyone therefore knows what they need to do, without one person having to keep reminding everyone else.
f123e6ae6e9e69841684e8c63bff4aa667cc5064.french: Chacun sait donc ce qu'il doit prévoir, sans qu'une personne ait à tout rappeler.

f15188ecbe0207e383aac2c97ae542cf613a6cc0.english: They are then able to look after their own laundry without relying on anyone else.
f15188ecbe0207e383aac2c97ae542cf613a6cc0.french: Il sait alors s'occuper de son linge sans dépendre de quelqu'un d'autre.

f6d75a9f8155df75ecf33d8e131e0ffaf4e7a8d2.english: Yes, I think household chores should be shared, according to each person’s abilities. That doesn’t mean asking the same of a child as of an adult. We ensure that one person doesn’t have to do everything, we learn useful skills and we organise the home more effectively.
f6d75a9f8155df75ecf33d8e131e0ffaf4e7a8d2.french: Oui, je pense que les tâches ménagères doivent être partagées, selon les possibilités de chacun. Cela ne veut pas dire demander la même chose à un enfant et à un adulte. On évite qu'une personne fasse tout, on apprend les gestes utiles et on organise mieux la maison.

f8e033dd997de6b241e968e81f0b0657bd915825.english: So yes, everyone should contribute. Fair sharing frees up time, prepares people for independence and prevents one person doing everything, including thinking about what needs doing.
f8e033dd997de6b241e968e81f0b0657bd915825.french: Donc oui, chacun devrait contribuer. Un partage juste libère du temps, prépare à l'autonomie et évite qu'une seule personne fasse tout, y compris penser à ce qu'il faut faire.
f8e033dd997de6b241e968e81f0b0657bd915825.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

fb02e220190a1c5b70b4e5d5171d0a9e31f102f2.english: The person responsible for shopping checks the cupboards, prepares the list and buys the items. If they wait to be told every item, someone else is still doing a large part of the work.
fb02e220190a1c5b70b4e5d5171d0a9e31f102f2.french: La personne responsable des courses vérifie les placards, prépare la liste et achète les produits. Si elle attend qu'on lui dicte chaque article, quelqu'un d'autre fait encore une grande partie du travail.
fb02e220190a1c5b70b4e5d5171d0a9e31f102f2.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

013ba98a4f7182cbb29998fa613512036932304c.english: Everyone contributes something to life together.
013ba98a4f7182cbb29998fa613512036932304c.french: Chacun apporte quelque chose à la vie commune.

03442ea9bddfb58c729fe126da445653574256a8.english: An adult might cook dinner on days when they finish work early, whilst their parents do the shopping on another day. They agree on roles in advance, without the parents having to organise everything and keep reminding them.
03442ea9bddfb58c729fe126da445653574256a8.french: Un adulte peut préparer le dîner les jours où il termine tôt, tandis que ses parents font les courses un autre jour. Ils définissent les rôles à l'avance, sans que les parents aient à tout organiser et rappeler.

10384067de57a19b217268afac8eb15c5c6422e8.english: Of course, some parents lack space or money, and difficult relationships sometimes rule out this solution. Conversely, living together long term may suit a family. Being independent does not require moving out by a specific date.
10384067de57a19b217268afac8eb15c5c6422e8.french: Bien sûr, certains parents manquent d'espace ou de moyens, et des relations difficiles empêchent parfois cette solution. À l'inverse, une vie commune durable peut convenir à une famille. L'autonomie n'impose pas de déménager à une date précise.
10384067de57a19b217268afac8eb15c5c6422e8.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

17ea72fa7aa987b47e90136b63745b85ac7e67a3.deepl_english: After a break-up, a 28-year-old might feel lonely in their flat in the evenings. Living with their parents, they can enjoy shared meals and have someone to talk to. They organise their own nights out without having to ask permission: they no longer have to go through this period alone.
17ea72fa7aa987b47e90136b63745b85ac7e67a3.english: After a break-up, a 28-year-old might feel lonely in their flat in the evenings. Living with their parents, they can enjoy shared meals and have someone to talk to. They organise their own outings without having to ask permission: they no longer have to go through this period alone.
17ea72fa7aa987b47e90136b63745b85ac7e67a3.french: Après une séparation, une personne de vingt-huit ans se sent seule le soir dans son appartement. Chez ses parents, elle retrouve des repas partagés et quelqu'un avec qui parler. Elle organise elle-même ses sorties, sans devoir demander la permission : elle n'a plus à traverser cette période seule.
17ea72fa7aa987b47e90136b63745b85ac7e67a3.review_note: Sorties means outings in general; it does not restrict this adult's independent plans to nights out.

1e59217eb3d88d9daabd5bd3644bd56ec1e3d0c4.english: A son does the heavy shopping and prepares dinner when his father gets home late. His father saves him from paying for a home alone; the son takes responsibility for part of daily life.
1e59217eb3d88d9daabd5bd3644bd56ec1e3d0c4.french: Un fils fait les courses lourdes et prépare le dîner quand son père rentre tard. Son père lui évite de payer un logement seul ; lui prend en charge une partie du quotidien.
1e59217eb3d88d9daabd5bd3644bd56ec1e3d0c4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

26c46c26fa1865a4f48283ea943d9237a929daca.english: Living with your parents after twenty-five can be practical and reasonable. It reduces expenses and allows mutual help in both directions. But material comfort is not enough: everyone must retain privacy and the ability to make their own decisions.
26c46c26fa1865a4f48283ea943d9237a929daca.french: Vivre chez ses parents après vingt-cinq ans peut être pratique et raisonnable. Cela réduit les dépenses et permet une entraide dans les deux sens. Mais le confort matériel ne suffit pas : chacun doit garder de l'intimité et la possibilité de prendre ses propres décisions.
26c46c26fa1865a4f48283ea943d9237a929daca.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2b5c1d6db6ab589f633f066a5d86d878bb6697d6.english: An adult woman who comes home late lets her parents know without asking permission to go out. In return, she avoids making noise and respects shared spaces.
2b5c1d6db6ab589f633f066a5d86d878bb6697d6.french: Une adulte qui rentre tard prévient ses parents sans demander l'autorisation de sortir. En échange, elle évite le bruit et respecte les espaces communs.
2b5c1d6db6ab589f633f066a5d86d878bb6697d6.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

37584e10c9fe2d5b6a62b83e151d67109cc9ac16.english: Preparing a meal or doing the shopping for several people can sometimes save everyone from having to do it separately. This works if the adults genuinely pitch in, rather than leaving the parents to do everything.
37584e10c9fe2d5b6a62b83e151d67109cc9ac16.french: Préparer un repas ou faire les courses pour plusieurs personnes évite parfois que chacun s'en occupe séparément. Cela fonctionne si les adultes participent vraiment, au lieu de laisser les parents tout faire.

3b5c6986c3fda8c802c1ae96db62abe659951a87.english: The young adult can contribute to expenses, meals or paperwork. The parents provide a home and daily company. Everything need not be perfectly equal, but everyone must know what they contribute and what others expect.
3b5c6986c3fda8c802c1ae96db62abe659951a87.french: Le jeune adulte peut contribuer aux dépenses, aux repas ou aux démarches. Les parents apportent un logement et une présence quotidienne. Il n'est pas nécessaire que tout soit parfaitement égal, mais chacun doit connaître sa contribution et les attentes des autres.
3b5c6986c3fda8c802c1ae96db62abe659951a87.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

3b9521c9b813e21c9bd791bc16027c60b411ddb3.english: So yes, staying with your parents can be practical if everyone benefits. The criterion is not age, but the balance between savings, mutual help and independence.
3b9521c9b813e21c9bd791bc16027c60b411ddb3.french: Donc oui, rester chez ses parents peut être pratique si chacun y trouve son compte. Le critère n'est pas l'âge, mais l'équilibre entre économies, entraide et indépendance.
3b9521c9b813e21c9bd791bc16027c60b411ddb3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

46e77544408f08d15d52e15e98be03a5ae50544c.english: Next, living together can be an exchange rather than simply somewhere to stay.
46e77544408f08d15d52e15e98be03a5ae50544c.french: Ensuite, la cohabitation peut être un échange plutôt qu'un simple hébergement.
46e77544408f08d15d52e15e98be03a5ae50544c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4bd60c3e4b80452265e634a42247e9f21e3814af.english: She keeps her freedom while her parents know what to expect and can sleep in peace.
4bd60c3e4b80452265e634a42247e9f21e3814af.french: Elle garde sa liberté tandis que ses parents savent à quoi s'attendre et peuvent dormir au calme.
4bd60c3e4b80452265e634a42247e9f21e3814af.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

59353cff3ba4d6959d2071c4a16b82504a2d4283.english: When so much is changing around us, returning to familiar routines helps us feel at home. Having loved ones around can also help ensure we don’t end up alone with our worries, whilst still allowing us to make our own decisions.
59353cff3ba4d6959d2071c4a16b82504a2d4283.french: Quand beaucoup de choses changent autour de nous, retrouver des gestes familiers aide à se sentir chez soi. La présence de proches peut aussi aider à ne pas rester seul avec ses soucis, sans leur confier toutes ses décisions.

5f63edcdb71fce3bb4c85f02452a0b0cc0dd8f99.english: Finally, a practical solution must also respect adults' freedom.
5f63edcdb71fce3bb4c85f02452a0b0cc0dd8f99.french: Enfin, une solution pratique doit aussi respecter la liberté des adultes.
5f63edcdb71fce3bb4c85f02452a0b0cc0dd8f99.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

68b9ff59c64ecc3f7e309480a29af3c1f7dc9065.english: She can look for a job under less financial pressure, which reduces the risk of accepting an option in a hurry.
68b9ff59c64ecc3f7e309480a29af3c1f7dc9065.french: Elle peut chercher un poste avec moins de pression financière, ce qui réduit le risque d'accepter une solution dans l'urgence.
68b9ff59c64ecc3f7e309480a29af3c1f7dc9065.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

70b230ca1e1cc03b06292858bcbe721fcd3f40b5.english: At twenty-five, not everyone has a stable job or enough savings to live alone. Returning after a contract ends can avoid getting into debt to pay rent and allow time to plan what comes next.
70b230ca1e1cc03b06292858bcbe721fcd3f40b5.french: À vingt-cinq ans, tout le monde n'a pas un emploi stable ni assez d'épargne pour vivre seul. Revenir après une fin de contrat peut éviter de s'endetter pour un loyer et laisser le temps de préparer la suite.
70b230ca1e1cc03b06292858bcbe721fcd3f40b5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

71174064ff7cf0e35a663a483da57c29236b98b5.english: Yes, living with one’s parents after the age of 25 can be practical, provided it is a chosen arrangement. It is possible to reduce expenses, share household chores and benefit from family support, without giving up one’s adult life.
71174064ff7cf0e35a663a483da57c29236b98b5.french: Oui, vivre avec ses parents après 25 ans peut être pratique, si cette cohabitation est choisie. On peut réduire ses dépenses, partager les tâches et retrouver un soutien familial, sans renoncer à sa vie d'adulte.

7bc382fd026948710b907b979e01be7d5a08decc.english: In conclusion, living with one’s parents after the age of 25 can provide financial, practical and emotional support if everyone maintains their role as an adult. Age alone does not determine either maturity or the quality of this arrangement.
7bc382fd026948710b907b979e01be7d5a08decc.french: En conclusion, vivre chez ses parents après 25 ans peut apporter une aide financière, pratique et affective si chacun garde sa place d'adulte. L'âge seul ne décide ni de la maturité ni de la qualité de cet arrangement.

7d2a0418b0f7ff6a39f1e9d2dda7d253136f1f5b.english: First, the family home sometimes provides security during a transition.
7d2a0418b0f7ff6a39f1e9d2dda7d253136f1f5b.french: D'abord, le logement familial offre parfois une sécurité pendant une transition.
7d2a0418b0f7ff6a39f1e9d2dda7d253136f1f5b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

99177ffd12358ae56afe422432b751900be278c2.english: You can therefore use the money saved towards a project, even whilst contributing to family expenses.
99177ffd12358ae56afe422432b751900be278c2.french: On peut donc utiliser l'argent économisé pour un projet, même en participant aux dépenses familiales.

a44b13b484ef39247042f100b723e99307016b6e.english: A twenty-seven-year-old woman finishes a temporary contract. She returns to her parents' home for a few months, contributes to expenses from her savings and looks for a job without paying for a flat alone.
a44b13b484ef39247042f100b723e99307016b6e.french: Une femme de vingt-sept ans termine un contrat temporaire. Elle revient quelques mois chez ses parents, contribue aux dépenses avec ses économies et cherche un poste sans payer seule un appartement.
a44b13b484ef39247042f100b723e99307016b6e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a6870b620b57705ae44023e1e0eae55a4a0b4b22.english: Finally, returning to a familiar environment can help someone get through a difficult period.
a6870b620b57705ae44023e1e0eae55a4a0b4b22.french: Enfin, retrouver un cadre familier peut aider à traverser une période difficile.

b51c2975f664e2eb7dd143e8843eb5bbf27221aa.english: The situation becomes useful to both generations, rather than leaving the parent to take care of everything.
b51c2975f664e2eb7dd143e8843eb5bbf27221aa.french: La situation devient utile aux deux générations, au lieu de laisser le parent tout assurer.
b51c2975f664e2eb7dd143e8843eb5bbf27221aa.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b57f618450c46396c3e3e90fe69f5bb6a457538e.english: When you’re paying the rent and bills on your own, there’s sometimes little money left for anything else. By sharing these costs with your parents, you can save money or pay for training, even if you contribute to the household expenses.
b57f618450c46396c3e3e90fe69f5bb6a457538e.french: Quand on paie seul un loyer et des charges, il reste parfois peu d'argent pour autre chose. En partageant ces frais avec ses parents, on peut mettre de côté ou payer une formation, même si l'on participe aux dépenses.

cc489daa26be86b3fda4c5fa3c366a4c2f4e2a9b.english: Furthermore, living together can make certain tasks easier for everyone.
cc489daa26be86b3fda4c5fa3c366a4c2f4e2a9b.french: Ensuite, la vie commune peut simplifier certaines tâches pour tous.

d0d5c5176b337deeb4f7afc7f338569d83bfbf6b.english: However, this arrangement requires the parents’ consent and a home that allows for it. A lack of privacy or conflicts can make it a burden. A long-term living arrangement can work, but must be a choice made by both parties.
d0d5c5176b337deeb4f7afc7f338569d83bfbf6b.french: Cependant, cette organisation suppose l'accord des parents et un logement qui le permette. Le manque d'intimité ou les conflits peuvent la rendre pesante. Une cohabitation durable peut fonctionner, mais doit rester choisie de part et d'autre.

ea239816525d60988a34f2e92f3752fa8b6c4490.english: First and foremost, sharing a home can leave more money available for one’s own plans.
ea239816525d60988a34f2e92f3752fa8b6c4490.french: Tout d'abord, partager un logement peut laisser plus d'argent pour ses projets.

ebba4ccbf8ab8f9814fd318bc0e03a9ed957490b.english: Schedules, visitors and private spaces need to be discussed. The young adult respects the household, but their parents no longer decide all their choices. Without this balance, the savings can come with constant tension.
ebba4ccbf8ab8f9814fd318bc0e03a9ed957490b.french: Il faut discuter des horaires, des visites et des espaces privés. Le jeune respecte le foyer, mais les parents ne décident plus de tous ses choix. Sans cet équilibre, les économies peuvent s'accompagner de tensions permanentes.

ed1ffd4c554487e98388ae9e75498240e2b82bf4.english: It is therefore possible to have a supportive environment whilst still making your own decisions.
ed1ffd4c554487e98388ae9e75498240e2b82bf4.french: On peut donc être entouré tout en continuant à décider pour soi-même.

03442ea9bddfb58c729fe126da445653574256a8.english: An adult can cook dinner on days when they finish work early, whilst their parents do the shopping on another day. They define their roles in advance, without the parents having to organise everything and keep reminding them.
03442ea9bddfb58c729fe126da445653574256a8.french: Un adulte peut préparer le dîner les jours où il termine tôt, tandis que ses parents font les courses un autre jour. Ils définissent les rôles à l'avance, sans que les parents aient à tout organiser et rappeler.

07eaf40205bcb9e012487194e136b0cfab4b6a21.english: In an expensive city, rent sometimes takes up a large part of a first salary. If the family agrees, sharing expenses can help someone repay a loan or build up savings. Being comfortable at home can then help them move forward.
07eaf40205bcb9e012487194e136b0cfab4b6a21.french: Dans une ville chère, un loyer absorbe parfois une grande partie d'un premier salaire. Si la famille est d'accord, partager les dépenses peut aider à rembourser un prêt ou à constituer une épargne. Le confort peut alors servir à avancer.
07eaf40205bcb9e012487194e136b0cfab4b6a21.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

179d2ef49d86cd50bb893809866f7ef393089efd.english: A twenty-six-year-old woman works, pays her own expenses and cooks two evenings a week. She enjoys seeing her parents, but organises her own outings and plans.

1c21314f8f68d606baf4d7febfae7c6eeabac686.english: Next, staying with your parents can allow you to fund a specific project.
1c21314f8f68d606baf4d7febfae7c6eeabac686.french: Ensuite, rester chez ses parents peut permettre de financer un projet concret.

24f8e9b7ef27c1bbcbdeef830972be4c7c3aab45.english: I take a rather sympathetic view of these young Canadian adults. Feeling at home with one’s parents is not a flaw, and living elsewhere does not in itself prove independence. I would look above all at the quality of the relationships, the practical circumstances and each person’s contribution.
24f8e9b7ef27c1bbcbdeef830972be4c7c3aab45.french: Je porte un regard plutôt compréhensif sur ces jeunes adultes canadiens. Se sentir bien chez ses parents n'est pas un défaut, et vivre ailleurs ne prouve pas à lui seul l'autonomie. Je regarderais surtout la qualité des relations, les possibilités matérielles et la contribution de chacun.

37584e10c9fe2d5b6a62b83e151d67109cc9ac16.english: Preparing a meal or doing the shopping for several people can sometimes prevent everyone from having to do it separately. This works if the adults genuinely contribute, rather than leaving the parents to do everything.
37584e10c9fe2d5b6a62b83e151d67109cc9ac16.french: Préparer un repas ou faire les courses pour plusieurs personnes évite parfois que chacun s'en occupe séparément. Cela fonctionne si les adultes participent vraiment, au lieu de laisser les parents tout faire.

3bb59aab5876c211c912a6271b353024e1c963fc.english: It is possible to enjoy time spent together whilst still having one’s own job, friends and personal choices. There is no reason to leave home simply to conform to a certain image of adulthood.
3bb59aab5876c211c912a6271b353024e1c963fc.french: On peut apprécier les moments communs tout en ayant son travail, ses amis et ses décisions personnelles. Il n'y a pas de raison de quitter un logement uniquement pour correspondre à une image de l'âge adulte.

6bce674d8f4eae9c17117480b037e61ac6192a9b.english: That said, I understand criticism of someone who refuses to contribute when they have the means to do so. But this behaviour does not represent all young people living with their family. No single age for leaving home suits every situation.
6bce674d8f4eae9c17117480b037e61ac6192a9b.french: Cela dit, je comprends les critiques envers quelqu'un qui refuse de contribuer alors qu'il en a les moyens. Mais ce comportement ne représente pas tous les jeunes qui vivent en famille. Aucun âge de départ ne convient à toutes les situations.
6bce674d8f4eae9c17117480b037e61ac6192a9b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

794785831b42334ae25930ac8c51384f59c064fe.english: Finally, living together can simplify certain tasks for everyone.

7bd575997484dcb163fff7ec5e76fb9eed2d89bc.english: This choice may therefore stem from a pleasant relationship, not from a refusal to make an effort.
7bd575997484dcb163fff7ec5e76fb9eed2d89bc.french: Ce choix peut donc venir d'une relation agréable, pas d'un refus de faire des efforts.

7e88df36a5f5c16bc2f25b291a6db1f6b458c321.deepl_english: In conclusion, I would not judge these young people on their ability to cope. Respectful relationships, a well-thought-out budget and genuine involvement matter more than moving out on a date considered ‘normal’.
7e88df36a5f5c16bc2f25b291a6db1f6b458c321.english: In conclusion, I would not judge these young people by where they live. Respectful relationships, a well-thought-out budget and genuine involvement matter more than moving out on a date considered ‘normal’.
7e88df36a5f5c16bc2f25b291a6db1f6b458c321.french: En conclusion, je ne jugerais pas ces jeunes sur leur adresse. Des relations respectueuses, un budget réfléchi et une participation réelle comptent davantage qu'un départ à une date considérée comme normale.
7e88df36a5f5c16bc2f25b291a6db1f6b458c321.review_note: Adresse means their address or living situation, not their ability to cope.

81842746501e4583e34dd1a5541f982cbd533ff8.english: I understand why a young adult might prefer to live with their parents because they feel happy there. Getting on well as a family is a blessing, not a fault. But they must take responsibility: living with their parents does not mean leaving them to take care of everything.
81842746501e4583e34dd1a5541f982cbd533ff8.french: Je comprends qu'un jeune adulte préfère vivre chez ses parents parce qu'il s'y sent bien. Une bonne entente familiale est une chance, pas un défaut. 867d865f152754c34ba313c5133b5a5ceb4da2c8.english: The young adult's comfort then does not come at the expense of his parents' comfort.

8b18806415d29040073c1398945ce31d320955e1.french: Enfin, il faut que cette cohabitation convienne aussi aux parents.

9e1398090f769e87eceafb0ad147fa290b7eb992.english: First and foremost, a happy family life can be a choice, not a refusal to grow up.
9e1398090f769e87eceafb0ad147fa290b7eb992.french: Tout d'abord, une vie familiale agréable peut être un choix, pas un refus de grandir.

a3fed9a2cc91a79bd804cbd3de0cf4affda2c13a.english: First, enjoying family life does not mean refusing to grow up.
a3fed9a2cc91a79bd804cbd3de0cf4affda2c13a.french: D'abord, apprécier la vie familiale ne signifie pas refuser de grandir.

b1f09f2cd36a314731ecdf161183c725dbeff387.english: Feeling comfortable at home is not enough if someone else does all the work. Parents also need peace and privacy. Everyone must be able to express their limits regarding expenses, chores or visitors.

b1f09f2cd36a314731ecdf161183c725dbeff387.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b51f0bfb47dc44178478b497df96ddbccf686ff5.english: A young adult finishing their studies can compare the cost of independent accommodation with their financial resources. With their parents’ consent, they can stay at home and regularly put money aside to prepare for moving out.
b51f0bfb47dc44178478b497df96ddbccf686ff5.french: Un jeune adulte qui termine une formation peut comparer le coût d'un logement indépendant avec ses ressources. Avec l'accord de ses parents, il peut rester chez eux et mettre régulièrement de l'argent de côté pour préparer son installation.

bcbad991e9baecbd42153812a5dec8accd4fa995.english: However, parents must also be able to express their needs. c17be5ec7e9d45e1ba39c80ad3db9e879c24c267.english: This arrangement can allow time to prepare for the future, without making an immediate move an obligation.

df9b94600e714e79b7dd2885ac62f794ec2162e1.french: Un jeune salarié convient avec ses parents de rester un an, de participer aux charges et d'épargner chaque mois pour son futur logement.
df9b94600e714e79b7dd2885ac62f794ec2162e1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e4ee50003221fa19750c24dfc9a6f6cdf2ac7bd6.english: Furthermore, staying in the family home can make it easier to fund a project.
e4ee50003221fa19750c24dfc9a6f6cdf2ac7bd6.french: Ensuite, rester au domicile familial peut rendre un projet plus facile à financer.

ed36cc963aa082a240c1d4a63e5c95e443d07e37.english: The choice also depends on income and the availability of suitable accommodation. Cutting back on certain expenses can make it possible to undertake training or build up savings, rather than committing to a budget that is impossible to stick to.
ed36cc963aa082a240c1d4a63e5c95e443d07e37.french: Le choix dépend aussi des revenus et des logements accessibles. Réduire certaines dépenses peut permettre de suivre une formation ou de constituer une réserve, plutôt que s'engager dans un budget impossible à tenir.

eee62f9cb5795957d4ac76d4bae36a6256bba298.english: A young working woman may enjoy having dinner with her parents several evenings a week, whilst organising her own outings and plans. If everyone respects each other’s personal space and schedules, this close living arrangement does not prevent her from having a personal life.
eee62f9cb5795957d4ac76d4bae36a6256bba298.french: Une jeune salariée peut aimer dîner avec ses parents plusieurs soirs par semaine, tout en organisant ses sorties et ses projets elle-même. Si chacun respecte son espace et ses horaires, cette proximité n'empêche pas une vie personnelle.

f18779fffc3240cb11147f511232bf69f8e0f3c9.english: You can enjoy family meals and conversations while working, managing your money and making your own decisions. Conversely, having your own flat does not stop you relying on your parents to sort out every problem.
f18779fffc3240cb11147f511232bf69f8e0f3c9.french: On peut aimer les repas et les discussions en famille tout en travaillant, en gérant son argent et en prenant ses décisions. Inversement, avoir son appartement n'empêche pas de dépendre de ses parents pour régler chaque problème.
f18779fffc3240cb11147f511232bf69f8e0f3c9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f473638c5b7afecf317bc79dfd812372ac0492c1.english: He will be better prepared to move out, with less risk of having to return at the first unexpected expense.

ff1c0360c8212f2de790aa5331c4f87f5b7a5919.french: Si un fils reçoit des amis tard alors que sa mère se lève tôt, ils peuvent convenir de les inviter le samedi plutôt qu'en semaine.
ff1c0360c8212f2de790aa5331c4f87f5b7a5919.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

04a5cb7aab6c3527479099b76b44bde5461f1e50.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

10b90e85759624c3081a7007314ed2f319cd6716.french: Un grand-parent conseille de déposer un CV directement dans une entreprise. Or, celle-ci exige une candidature en ligne avec un numéro de dossier : cette démarche seule ne suffit pas.
10b90e85759624c3081a7007314ed2f319cd6716.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1158fc6579c03b0fea0fd612737a7811b025512e.english: First and foremost, the experience of older people can help us avoid certain mistakes.
1158fc6579c03b0fea0fd612737a7811b025512e.french: Tout d'abord, l'expérience des aînés peut nous aider à éviter certaines erreurs.

20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.english: Of course, rejecting advice simply because it comes from an older person would be unfair. Many remain very well informed. I would also check whether a friend my own age really knows the subject and understands my situation.
20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.french: Bien sûr, rejeter un avis simplement parce qu'il vient d'une personne âgée serait injuste. Beaucoup restent très informées. Je vérifierais aussi si un ami de mon âge connaît vraiment le sujet et comprend ma situation.
20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

386ced74c80883e8e56df5419ae847d451208b89.english: A grandfather who has changed careers might explain that he left his job before checking the cost of his training. He advises his granddaughter to weigh up the costs against her savings before resigning.
386ced74c80883e8e56df5419ae847d451208b89.french: Un grand-père qui a changé de métier peut expliquer qu'il avait quitté son emploi avant de vérifier le coût de sa formation. Il conseille à sa petite-fille de comparer les frais et ses économies avant de démissionner.

3951fe37b4abe634909f1789473a6ad5ff03b5ba.english: However, it would be just as unfair to reject advice simply because it comes from an older person. 3951fe37b4abe634909f1789473a6ad5ff03b5ba.french: Cependant, il serait tout aussi injuste de rejeter un conseil parce qu'il vient d'une personne âgée.
