427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.english: Next, past experience does not provide all the answers to today's problems.
427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.french: Ensuite, l'expérience du passé ne donne pas toutes les réponses aux problèmes actuels.
427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4e19ce14d42bbb5d8cc9de144565a3b0f35ddfa9.english: Furthermore, a loved one who knows us well is better placed to take our needs into account.
4e19ce14d42bbb5d8cc9de144565a3b0f35ddfa9.french: Ensuite, un proche qui nous connaît bien peut mieux tenir compte de nos besoins.

58b31cb3550583721bd16a0d2b67ff1292dae8df.english: In conclusion, I recommend listening to older people with respect, but not obeying them automatically. Experience, active listening and adapting to the context are what make advice valuable, far more so than age alone.
58b31cb3550583721bd16a0d2b67ff1292dae8df.french: En conclusion, je recommande d'écouter les aînés avec respect, mais pas d'obéir automatiquement. L'expérience, l'écoute et l'adaptation au contexte font la qualité d'un conseil, bien davantage que l'âge seul.

7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.deepl_english: A loved one who listens to our wishes and constraints can help us weigh up various options to find the one that suits us best. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.english: Someone close to us who listens to what we want and the constraints we face can help us compare several options to find one that suits us. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.french: Un proche qui écoute nos envies et nos contraintes peut nous aider à comparer plusieurs possibilités pour trouver celle qui nous convient. Cette qualité dépend de la relation, pas automatiquement de son âge.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.review_note: Keep un proche broad and the listening/constraints wording natural; finding a suitable option does not claim it is the best one.

801dcc672233acbb7ef52a8d6048721e43e9898d.english: Someone who has been through a similar situation can explain what went wrong and what they would do differently. Their account can help us avoid a mistake, without us having to follow exactly in their footsteps.
801dcc672233acbb7ef52a8d6048721e43e9898d.french: Une personne qui a traversé une situation proche peut expliquer ce qui a mal tourné et ce qu'elle ferait autrement. Son récit peut nous éviter une erreur, sans qu'on soit obligé de reproduire exactement son parcours.

80b8e1179e39f9d31490abe9070802d679476227.english: A grandfather might advise you to take your CV straight to a company, just as he used to do. But if the vacancy requires you to apply via a platform, following his advice is no substitute for applying online.
80b8e1179e39f9d31490abe9070802d679476227.french: Un grand-père peut conseiller de passer directement dans une entreprise avec son CV, comme il le faisait. Mais si l'offre demande de candidater sur une plateforme, suivre son conseil ne remplace pas la candidature en ligne.

875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.deepl_english: This advice helps you to make a choice, without deciding for someone else.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.english: This advice helps the other person make a choice, without making the decision for them.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.french: Ce conseil aide à choisir, sans décider à la place de l'autre.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.review_note: Preserves the distinction between the adviser and the person receiving advice.

8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.english: Finally, even well-informed advice may not match our priorities.
8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.french: Enfin, même un conseil bien informé peut ne pas correspondre à nos priorités.
8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.english: In conclusion, experience deserves to be listened to, not followed blindly. Good advice depends on relevance and listening, not just age.
8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.french: En conclusion, l'expérience mérite d'être écoutée, pas suivie aveuglément. Un bon conseil dépend de sa pertinence et de l'écoute, pas seulement de l'âge.
8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

938a01c7200e6f925b74d397ebe0fa9004a36c41.english: Some people value security, others creativity or freedom. An older person may want to protect us by recommending the choice they made themselves. To be useful, advice must also take our abilities and wishes into account.
938a01c7200e6f925b74d397ebe0fa9004a36c41.french: Certains privilégient la sécurité, d'autres la créativité ou la liberté. Un aîné peut vouloir nous protéger en recommandant son propre choix. Pour qu'un conseil soit utile, il faut aussi qu'il tienne compte de nos capacités et de nos envies.
938a01c7200e6f925b74d397ebe0fa9004a36c41.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.english: The student can consider a solution instead of making a final decision in the heat of disappointment.
97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.french: L'étudiant peut envisager une solution au lieu de prendre une décision définitive sous le coup de la déception.
97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9972a676c0e1031d608abc4b48067136f9b93d7a.english: I disagree with the word ‘always’. Older people can give very useful advice, but age is no guarantee. What matters is their experience, but also what they know about our situation and current realities.
9972a676c0e1031d608abc4b48067136f9b93d7a.french: Je ne suis pas d'accord avec le mot « toujours ». Les personnes âgées peuvent donner des conseils très utiles, mais l'âge n'est pas une garantie. Ce qui compte, c'est leur expérience, mais aussi ce qu'elles savent de notre situation et des réalités actuelles.

9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.english: The advice helps her think things through, but does not replace the decision of the person concerned.
9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.french: Le conseil aide à réfléchir, mais ne remplace pas la décision de la personne concernée.
9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9a9c0c03b3e3fe3c0a09509461228a20a097f729.english: Finally, advice based on an old method may no longer be appropriate today.
9a9c0c03b3e3fe3c0a09509461228a20a097f729.french: Enfin, un conseil fondé sur une ancienne méthode peut ne plus convenir aujourd'hui.

a051b9bb8324dd2d258fd3a779523080bdb646d4.english: Recruitment procedures and training programmes are constantly evolving. A solution that worked in the past may no longer be acceptable, even if the person recommending it has good intentions.
a051b9bb8324dd2d258fd3a779523080bdb646d4.french: Les procédures de recrutement ou les formations évoluent. Une solution qui a fonctionné autrefois peut ne plus être acceptée, même si la personne la recommande avec de bonnes intentions.

a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.english: After a first failure, we sometimes think everything is over. An older person can explain how they overcame a similar experience. Their advice is then based on lived experience, not just reassuring words.
a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.french: Après un premier échec, on pense parfois que tout est terminé. Une personne plus âgée peut raconter comment elle a surmonté une expérience comparable. Son conseil s'appuie alors sur du vécu, pas seulement sur une formule rassurante.
a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a8f36653883ecbcabfd7925e3c382876aa0b6ed9.english: A student fails an exam and wants to give up. His grandfather explains that he returned to education after a failure and suggests first looking at what went wrong.
a8f36653883ecbcabfd7925e3c382876aa0b6ed9.french: Un étudiant rate un examen et veut abandonner. Son grand-père raconte qu'il a repris des études après un échec et lui propose de chercher d'abord ce qui n'a pas fonctionné.
a8f36653883ecbcabfd7925e3c382876aa0b6ed9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ac0772aa8043fcf79cd84a8802c9240be41c64f4.english: A loved one who listens to our wishes and constraints can help us distinguish our own plans from the expectations of others. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
ac0772aa8043fcf79cd84a8802c9240be41c64f4.french: Un proche qui écoute nos envies et nos contraintes peut nous aider à distinguer notre projet des attentes des autres. Cette qualité dépend de la relation, pas automatiquement de son âge.

aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.english: Older people often give good advice, but not always. Their experience can help us gain perspective. However, some situations have changed, and their priorities are not necessarily ours. I prefer to listen to their views, then decide according to my own situation.
aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.french: Les personnes âgées donnent souvent de bons conseils, mais pas toujours. Leur expérience peut aider à prendre du recul. Certaines situations ont toutefois changé, et leurs priorités ne sont pas forcément les nôtres. Je préfère écouter leur avis, puis décider selon ma situation.
aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

bdbd64dca3267b48ed4120147d60bc20326b8612.english: A grandmother recommends a stable job near the family to her granddaughter, who wants to work abroad. They can compare the risks and budget without condemning her decision to leave.
bdbd64dca3267b48ed4120147d60bc20326b8612.french: Une grand-mère recommande un emploi stable près de la famille à sa petite-fille, qui souhaite travailler à l'étranger. Elles peuvent comparer les risques et le budget sans condamner le départ.
bdbd64dca3267b48ed4120147d60bc20326b8612.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c8d8f219940847ac099a31f4a2a17bb2f3f780c0.english: Recruitment, training and housing conditions change. Advice may be well intentioned but based on outdated assumptions. Before acting, we therefore need to check the information relevant to the current situation.
c8d8f219940847ac099a31f4a2a17bb2f3f780c0.french: Le recrutement, les formations et les conditions de logement évoluent. Un conseil peut être bien intentionné, mais reposer sur des repères dépassés. Avant d'agir, il faut donc vérifier les informations qui concernent la situation actuelle.
c8d8f219940847ac099a31f4a2a17bb2f3f780c0.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

caff10e81978e69300285eb8c28ba75e7c720d30.english: This advice helps them check whether their plan is financially viable before leaving their job.
caff10e81978e69300285eb8c28ba75e7c720d30.french: Ce conseil l'aide à vérifier si son projet est financièrement réaliste avant de quitter son emploi.

e072c82d71ac614fe64f99803d7a37b3bad14002.english: First, having been through difficulties can help someone put other people's problems into perspective.
e072c82d71ac614fe64f99803d7a37b3bad14002.french: D'abord, avoir traversé des difficultés peut aider à relativiser celles des autres.
e072c82d71ac614fe64f99803d7a37b3bad14002.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e3b2ceed631cb8df21ed22875d83fee1c41b84da.english: Advice must therefore take current rules into account to be truly useful.
e3b2ceed631cb8df21ed22875d83fee1c41b84da.french: Le conseil doit donc tenir compte des règles actuelles pour être vraiment utile.

f883b017147a6e646c39c2f9e9fe5b05fa6be742.deepl_english: A student is torn between two universities. His elderly aunt knows he has a penchant for practical work: they compare the role of workshops in the curricula. He discovers that one offers mainly theoretical courses, whilst the other is better suited to his way of learning.
f883b017147a6e646c39c2f9e9fe5b05fa6be742.english: A student is torn between two schools. His elderly aunt knows he has a preference for practical work: they compare the role of workshops in the curricula. He discovers that one offers mainly theoretical courses, whilst the other is better suited to his way of learning.
f883b017147a6e646c39c2f9e9fe5b05fa6be742.french: Un étudiant hésite entre deux écoles. Sa tante âgée connaît son goût pour la pratique : ils comparent la place des ateliers dans les programmes. Il découvre que l'une propose surtout des cours théoriques, alors que l'autre correspond mieux à sa façon d'apprendre.
f883b017147a6e646c39c2f9e9fe5b05fa6be742.review_note: Écoles does not establish that both institutions are universities.

01d11d660dc7f1e71a162fdee63688912462b106.english: Next, children often notice the changes we try to hide from them.
01d11d660dc7f1e71a162fdee63688912462b106.french: Ensuite, les enfants remarquent souvent les changements qu'on essaie de leur cacher.
01d11d660dc7f1e71a162fdee63688912462b106.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

0b91d73e9022eb0a070ae94388803e3735f68aee.english: The situation remains difficult, but becomes less confusing: the child understands what affects them.
0b91d73e9022eb0a070ae94388803e3735f68aee.french: La situation reste difficile, mais devient moins confuse : l'enfant comprend ce qui le concerne.
0b91d73e9022eb0a070ae94388803e3735f68aee.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

0c21644a28a6294c2cc743275a8a842083c0a4c8.english: If a child's parents separate, they can explain that they will no longer live together, but that it is not the child's fault. They explain where the child will sleep and when they will see each parent.
0c21644a28a6294c2cc743275a8a842083c0a4c8.french: Si ses parents se séparent, ils peuvent expliquer qu'ils ne vivront plus ensemble, mais qu'il n'y est pour rien. Ils précisent où il dormira et quand il verra chacun.
0c21644a28a6294c2cc743275a8a842083c0a4c8.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

18a215483e6638806031c15cef10188032ac2b94.deepl_english: A child wonders why her grandmother no longer comes to see her on Wednesdays. Her parents explain that she is in hospital after a fall and that carers are looking after her. They plan to have her ring, without promising a full recovery.
18a215483e6638806031c15cef10188032ac2b94.english: A child wonders why her grandmother no longer comes to see her on Wednesdays. Her parents explain that she is in hospital after a fall and that healthcare staff are looking after her. They arrange a call, without promising a recovery.
18a215483e6638806031c15cef10188032ac2b94.french: Une enfant se demande pourquoi sa grand-mère ne vient plus la voir le mercredi. Ses parents lui expliquent qu'elle est à l'hôpital après une chute et que des soignants s'occupent d'elle. Ils prévoient un appel, sans promettre une guérison.
18a215483e6638806031c15cef10188032ac2b94.review_note: Does not invent who must call or a full recovery; removes the unnatural have her ring.

19d7003c6a0ca40e2a3adcde9f54801408f548c1.english: Finally, telling the truth tactfully helps a child to accept failure and bounce back.
19d7003c6a0ca40e2a3adcde9f54801408f548c1.french: Enfin, dire la vérité avec tact aide l'enfant à accepter un échec et à rebondir.

2833955483abe5877c1ab9c41c10067ee401a240.english: Furthermore, a simple explanation can ease a child’s worries.
2833955483abe5877c1ab9c41c10067ee401a240.french: Ensuite, une explication simple peut réduire les inquiétudes de l'enfant.

2e67f46736f06c0382efb94a2169374fcdd7d44d.english: In conclusion, I would opt for an honest, gradual and caring approach. A truthful explanation helps children to understand and maintain trust, without them becoming the adults’ confidants.
2e67f46736f06c0382efb94a2169374fcdd7d44d.french: En conclusion, je choisirais une parole honnête, progressive et bienveillante. Une explication vraie aide à comprendre et à garder confiance, sans que l'enfant devienne le confident des adultes.

337270e55e2e32697b8630c02eac5b2a93cd61c3.english: If a promised outing is cancelled because a parent has to work, they can simply say so and acknowledge the child’s disappointment. Pretending that the venue is closed would complicate matters if the child later found out that their friends had gone there.
337270e55e2e32697b8630c02eac5b2a93cd61c3.french: Si une sortie promise est annulée parce que le parent doit travailler, il peut le dire simplement et reconnaître la déception. Prétendre que le lieu est fermé compliquerait la discussion si l'enfant apprenait ensuite que ses camarades y sont allés.

3662d6bd01d24d1960f0d48e804dd27ba375fc77.english: However, children do not need to know about every conflict or every detail of adults’ private lives. You can tell them that a question is personal or that you do not yet have an answer. Being honest does not mean telling them everything.
3662d6bd01d24d1960f0d48e804dd27ba375fc77.french: Cependant, l'enfant n'a pas à connaître tous les conflits ou tous les détails de la vie privée des adultes. On peut lui dire qu'une question est personnelle ou qu'on n'a pas encore de réponse. Être honnête, ce n'est pas tout lui raconter.

3bba67ca5e53dbb1818bf34eebfc0ec47a516ec9.english: A child notices absences or new habits without necessarily knowing the reason behind them. Without an explanation, they may imagine something far more serious than the reality.
3bba67ca5e53dbb1818bf34eebfc0ec47a516ec9.french: Un enfant remarque les absences ou les nouvelles habitudes sans forcément en connaître la cause. Sans explication, il peut imaginer quelque chose de plus grave que la réalité.

441aae6a160300a1de33a37a9b6e2d05cccfcb36.english: So yes to honesty, with carefully chosen words and a reassuring presence. The aim is to give an explanation that is true, useful and within the child's understanding.
441aae6a160300a1de33a37a9b6e2d05cccfcb36.french: Donc oui à l'honnêteté, avec des mots choisis et une présence rassurante. Il s'agit de donner une explication vraie, utile et à la portée de l'enfant.
441aae6a160300a1de33a37a9b6e2d05cccfcb36.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4a2f04957d27978c7072cc306b51c786205191b0.deepl_english: After losing a tennis match, a parent can acknowledge that their child missed a lot of serves, rather than making up a story about a refereeing error. They decide to work on that shot in training to prepare for the next match.
4a2f04957d27978c7072cc306b51c786205191b0.english: After their child loses a tennis match, a parent can acknowledge that the child missed a lot of serves, rather than making up a story about an umpiring error. They decide to work on the serve in training to prepare for the next match.
4a2f04957d27978c7072cc306b51c786205191b0.french: Après un match de tennis perdu, un parent peut reconnaître que son enfant a raté beaucoup de services, au lieu d'inventer une erreur d'arbitrage. Ils décident de travailler ce geste à l'entraînement pour préparer le prochain match.
4a2f04957d27978c7072cc306b51c786205191b0.review_note: The child lost the match, not the parent; umpire is the tennis term.

4dd8397998dce282d989d823dd0673e4f5b98782.english: They learn to use honest feedback to improve, rather than expecting only praise.
4dd8397998dce282d989d823dd0673e4f5b98782.french: Il apprend à utiliser un retour honnête pour s'améliorer, plutôt qu'à attendre uniquement des compliments.
4dd8397998dce282d989d823dd0673e4f5b98782.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4ffe60bdc22d274936ce2456ec40ac8d9d4765fd.english: The child may be disappointed by the decision whilst still believing the parent’s explanations.
4ffe60bdc22d274936ce2456ec40ac8d9d4765fd.french: L'enfant peut être déçu de la décision tout en continuant à croire les explications du parent.

62b478c90ce32737ffbb51f5cfa8e890894eb854.english: The child then knows why their grandmother is away and how to stay in touch with her.
62b478c90ce32737ffbb51f5cfa8e890894eb854.french: L'enfant sait alors pourquoi sa grand-mère est absente et comment garder le contact avec elle.

8864bfd0c9208ffb87ac18ab1eab9ce5f10ab335.english: The truth becomes a starting point for moving forward, not a way of belittling them.
8864bfd0c9208ffb87ac18ab1eab9ce5f10ab335.french: La vérité devient un point de départ pour progresser, pas une manière de rabaisser.

8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.english: Before a vaccination, you can say: "You will feel a little prick, but it does not last long and I will stay with you." That is better than promising they will not feel anything.
8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.french: Avant un vaccin, on peut dire : « Tu vas sentir une petite piqûre, mais ça dure peu de temps et je reste avec toi. » C'est mieux que promettre qu'il ne sentira rien.
8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.english: Finally, an honest answer can also help a child improve.
940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.french: Enfin, une réponse honnête peut aussi aider l'enfant à progresser.
940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.english: Before playing the piano in front of the class, the child asks whether they are ready. You can answer: "You know the beginning well, but you hesitate at the end. We can go over it together."
ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.french: Avant de jouer du piano devant la classe, il demande s'il est prêt. On peut répondre : « Tu connais bien le début, mais tu hésites à la fin. On peut la reprendre ensemble. »
ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.english: For me, it is better to tell children a simple truth than to invent a story to avoid a difficult conversation. Honesty maintains trust and helps them understand what they are going through. But it does not mean telling them everything as though they were adults.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.french: Pour moi, il vaut mieux dire une vérité simple aux enfants qu'inventer une histoire pour éviter une conversation difficile. L'honnêteté entretient la confiance et les aide à comprendre ce qu'ils vivent. Mais elle ne signifie pas tout raconter comme à un adulte.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.english: They hear an argument or see a parent crying. Without an explanation, they may invent an answer and believe they are responsible. The truth must therefore be adapted to their age, with simple words and time for their questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.french: Ils entendent une dispute ou voient un parent pleurer. Sans explication, ils peuvent inventer une réponse et se croire responsables. Il faut donc que la vérité soit adaptée à leur âge, avec des mots simples et du temps pour leurs questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.english: I believe we should prioritise the truth with children, but ‘always’ does not mean telling them everything straight away. You can be honest without giving all the details. The key is to choose words appropriate to the child’s age and to address what they need to understand.
b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.french: Je pense qu'il faut privilégier la vérité avec les enfants, mais « toujours » ne signifie pas tout raconter immédiatement. On peut être honnête sans donner tous les détails. L'essentiel est de choisir des mots adaptés à l'âge de l'enfant et de répondre à ce qu'il a besoin de comprendre.

c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.english: Encouragement does not mean saying everything is perfect. A child can hear that they still need to work on something if their efforts are recognised and someone explains how to do it. A difficulty is not a judgement of their worth.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.french: Encourager ne signifie pas dire que tout est parfait. Un enfant peut entendre qu'il doit encore travailler quelque chose si on reconnaît ses efforts et lui explique comment faire. Une difficulté n'est pas un jugement sur sa valeur.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.english: However, a child should not have to carry the burden of adults' relationship conflicts or financial worries. You can explain a restriction without asking them to solve the problem. And it is better to acknowledge uncertainty than to promise an outcome that is unknown.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.french: Cependant, l'enfant n'a pas à porter les conflits de couple ou les inquiétudes financières des adultes. On peut expliquer une restriction sans lui demander de résoudre le problème. Et mieux vaut reconnaître une incertitude que promettre une issue inconnue.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.english: If an adult makes up a reason that is easy to refute, the child may subsequently doubt their explanations. When their words remain trustworthy, the child can ask them questions without wondering whether they are hiding the real reason.
d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.french: Si l'adulte invente une raison facile à contredire, l'enfant peut ensuite douter de ses explications. Quand ses paroles restent fiables, l'enfant peut lui poser des questions sans se demander s'il cache la vraie raison.

d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.english: A false promise reassures them for a few moments, but may make them doubt the next explanation. An honest answer gives them something to rely on, even when it is not pleasant to hear.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.french: Une fausse promesse le rassure quelques instants, mais peut lui faire douter de la prochaine explication. Une réponse honnête lui donne un repère, même lorsqu'elle n'est pas agréable à entendre.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.english: They know what to expect and can see afterwards that the adult explained things accurately.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.french: Il sait à quoi s'attendre et constate ensuite que l'adulte lui avait expliqué les choses correctement.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.english: First and foremost, an honest explanation helps the child to trust the adult.
eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.french: Tout d'abord, une explication honnête aide l'enfant à faire confiance à l'adulte.

f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.english: First, a child must be able to believe what their parents tell them.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.french: D'abord, l'enfant doit pouvoir croire ce que ses parents lui disent.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.english: Making up an excuse may ease the child’s mind in the moment, but it does not help them understand their difficulties. The adult can acknowledge what went wrong, then work with the child to find ways to move forward.
ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.french: Inventer une excuse peut soulager l'enfant sur le moment, mais cela ne l'aide pas à comprendre ses difficultés. L'adulte peut reconnaître ce qui n'a pas marché, puis chercher avec lui comment progresser.

01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.english: The bond still exists, but takes more effort and sometimes leaves them feeling on the sidelines of family life.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.french: Le lien existe toujours, mais demande davantage d'efforts et laisse parfois le sentiment d'être à côté de la vie familiale.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

13009f665d39480da0169fac06a7122afb1d8acc.english: Someone living on their own might ring their family on a Sunday, only to find themselves eating dinner alone once the call has ended. The call allows them to catch up with their loved ones, but it cannot replace the meal they used to share with them.
13009f665d39480da0169fac06a7122afb1d8acc.french: Une personne installée seule peut appeler sa famille le dimanche, puis dîner sans compagnie une fois la conversation terminée. L'appel lui permet de prendre des nouvelles, mais ne remplace pas le repas qu'elle partageait avec ses proches.

19fe70afe8cb531c01a7bf1e474d993699822196.english: Being far away can therefore sometimes add to the organisational challenges, quite apart from the feeling of missing loved ones.
19fe70afe8cb531c01a7bf1e474d993699822196.french: L'éloignement ajoute donc parfois une difficulté d'organisation, au-delà du sentiment de manque.

2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.english: Loved ones can offer advice from a distance without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support and plan ahead more carefully for certain situations.
2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis et qu'on prévoie davantage certaines situations.

2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.english: Family can listen and give advice over the phone, but cannot always help in practical ways. At first, you do not necessarily know someone you can ask for a favour. It is therefore important to know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.french: La famille peut écouter et conseiller au téléphone, mais pas toujours intervenir concrètement. Au début, on ne connaît pas forcément quelqu'un à qui demander un service. Il est donc important qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.deepl_english: Loved ones can offer advice from afar without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support locally and know who to call in the event of an emergency.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.english: People close to us can offer advice from a distance without being able to make a journey or provide immediate help. We then need to find other support locally and know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis sur place et qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.review_note: An imprévu can be an unexpected scheduling problem, not an emergency; the unavailable journey need not be a visit to the speaker.

3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.english: Someone living abroad calls their family every Sunday. Yet, seeing a photo of an impromptu meal at their sister's home, they realise that this moment happened without them.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.french: Une personne installée à l'étranger appelle sa famille chaque dimanche. Pourtant, en voyant une photo du repas improvisé chez sa sœur, elle réalise que ce moment s'est passé sans elle.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.english: In conclusion, living far from one’s family isn’t necessarily easy: you have to cope with missing them, find support locally and plan visits. Phone calls and the connections you build with those around you can help, though they cannot replace all those moments spent with family.
40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.french: En conclusion, vivre loin de sa famille n'est pas forcément facile : il faut gérer le manque, trouver de l'aide sur place et prévoir les visites. Les appels et les liens qu'on crée autour de soi peuvent aider, sans remplacer tous les moments en famille.

4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.english: Finally, the distance can make it difficult to organise reunions.
4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.french: Enfin, la distance peut rendre les retrouvailles difficiles à organiser.

48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.english: Living far from your family takes real adjustment. You miss everyday moments, immediate help is no longer available and getting together takes planning. That does not mean regretting your move: you can love your new life while still missing your loved ones.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.french: Vivre loin de sa famille demande une vraie adaptation. Les moments ordinaires manquent, l'aide immédiate n'est plus disponible et les retrouvailles demandent une organisation. Cela ne signifie pas regretter son départ : on peut aimer sa nouvelle vie tout en ressentant le manque de ses proches.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.english: Next, you need to rebuild a support network close to home.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.french: Ensuite, il faut reconstruire un réseau d'entraide près de chez soi.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.english: Finally, distance sometimes prevents you being there when you want to be.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.french: Enfin, la distance empêche parfois d'être présent au moment souhaité.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.english: The desire to see one another does not, therefore, eliminate the constraints of time and money.
5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.french: La volonté de se voir ne supprime donc pas les contraintes de temps et de budget.

658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.english: Reliable friends and good relationships with neighbours make daily life more secure, without replacing family.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.french: Des amis fiables et de bonnes relations de voisinage rendent le quotidien plus sûr, sans remplacer la famille.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.english: First, you may come to miss small family routines.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.french: D'abord, les petites habitudes familiales peuvent finir par manquer.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6e5f856d5569a747c68ab94413c9148564a905a6.english: First and foremost, being far away can create a sense of emotional longing in everyday life.
6e5f856d5569a747c68ab94413c9148564a905a6.french: Tout d'abord, l'éloignement peut créer un manque affectif au quotidien.

75d7eac64ec6c3667b5c7e9d81878b8a2f2a4f7e.english: Furthermore, certain needs require help that is available locally.
75d7eac64ec6c3667b5c7e9d81878b8a2f2a4f7e.french: Ensuite, certains besoins demandent une aide disponible sur place.

8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.english: The emotional sense of missing someone is then compounded by the practical frustration of being unable to be there.
8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.french: Au manque affectif s'ajoute alors la frustration concrète de ne pas pouvoir être là.
8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

88d28354d079554e2ef4eb23d63cdf905228a5ac.deepl_english: One parent now lives far from the grandparents, who used to pick up their child from school from time to time. One evening when he finishes work late, he calls a trusted neighbour, who has already been authorised to collect his child. She agrees to do so: he has found another local support network.
88d28354d079554e2ef4eb23d63cdf905228a5ac.english: A parent now lives far from the grandparents, who used to pick up their child from school from time to time. One evening when they finish work late, they call a trusted neighbour, who has already been authorised to collect their child. She agrees to do so: the parent has found someone else to help locally.
88d28354d079554e2ef4eb23d63cdf905228a5ac.french: Un parent habite maintenant loin des grands-parents, qui récupéraient parfois son enfant à l'école. Un soir où il finit tard, il appelle une voisine de confiance, déjà autorisée à récupérer son enfant. Elle accepte de le faire : il a trouvé un autre relais sur place.
88d28354d079554e2ef4eb23d63cdf905228a5ac.review_note: One neighbour providing a relais is not a whole support network; keeps the parent pronouns consistent.

8f7e000151c85963899fca3899543d329e790cc5.english: Travelling requires money, leave from work and sometimes administrative arrangements. You cannot go home for every birthday. This constraint becomes particularly difficult when you want to support a loved one quickly, rather than simply arrange a holiday.
8f7e000151c85963899fca3899543d329e790cc5.french: Voyager suppose un budget, des congés et parfois des démarches administratives. On ne peut pas rentrer pour chaque anniversaire. La contrainte devient particulièrement difficile quand on veut soutenir un proche rapidement, et pas seulement organiser des vacances.
8f7e000151c85963899fca3899543d329e790cc5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

94df459eefcb16040572a67a9708be2fcfa3252d.english: Distance turns a simple visit into a trip that requires planning. Holidays, work schedules and budget constraints can limit the frequency of reunions, even when everyone would like to see each other more often.
94df459eefcb16040572a67a9708be2fcfa3252d.french: La distance transforme une visite simple en déplacement à préparer. Les congés, les horaires et le budget peuvent limiter la fréquence des retrouvailles, même quand chacun souhaite se voir davantage.

987c77c08987725f46d42f3bafc1f3abb2baada5.english: Even with regular phone calls, this person may still feel the absence of their family.
987c77c08987725f46d42f3bafc1f3abb2baada5.french: Même avec des appels réguliers, cette personne peut donc ressentir le manque de sa famille.

a26a9ba0689ee9090c545f79278b4b9a6b725a09.english: Someone who is ill needs to collect some medicine, while their parents are several hours away by plane. If they know a neighbour who is available, they may be able to ask them for this favour.
a26a9ba0689ee9090c545f79278b4b9a6b725a09.french: Une personne malade doit récupérer un médicament, alors que ses parents sont à plusieurs heures d'avion. Si elle connaît un voisin disponible, elle pourra peut-être lui demander ce service.
a26a9ba0689ee9090c545f79278b4b9a6b725a09.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b8ebbfde4496c708f3e68e55e78c9c1c7d1780df.english: A daughter who lives an eight-hour train journey from her parents would like to come home for her father’s birthday. She would have to take two days off work and pay for a ticket that is beyond her budget. So she decides not to come, even though she really wants to be there.
b8ebbfde4496c708f3e68e55e78c9c1c7d1780df.french: Une fille qui habite à huit heures de train de ses parents voudrait venir pour l'anniversaire de son père. Elle devrait poser deux jours de congé et payer un billet qui dépasse son budget. Elle renonce donc à venir, même si elle tient à être présente.

d553d3c609426ad732c26fdd6bbee0d8eadc9861.english: When relationships are good, living far from one’s family can still be difficult. You miss the little moments, practical help is less readily available, and visits take time and money. Nevertheless, it is possible to build a fulfilling life elsewhere.
d553d3c609426ad732c26fdd6bbee0d8eadc9861.french: Quand les relations sont bonnes, vivre loin de sa famille peut être difficile. Les petits moments manquent, l'aide pratique est moins accessible et les visites demandent du temps et de l'argent. On peut néanmoins construire une vie satisfaisante ailleurs.

d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.english: In short, living far from your family is not always simple, but you can still be happy. Regular contact, planned visits and a local life help you find a balance.
d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.french: Bref, vivre loin des siens n'est pas toujours simple, mais reste compatible avec le bonheur. Un contact régulier, des visites préparées et une vie locale aident à trouver son équilibre.
d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.english: If a mother is admitted to hospital, her son living abroad may want to come immediately. But the ticket price and the leave he needs to arrange sometimes force him to wait several days.
dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.french: Si une mère est hospitalisée, son fils vivant à l'étranger peut vouloir venir immédiatement. Mais le prix du billet et les congés à obtenir l'obligent parfois à attendre plusieurs jours.
dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.english: That said, choosing to move for a project you care about can be enriching, especially with routines and friendships where you live. You are not necessarily happier near your family when relationships are difficult.
dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.french: Cela dit, un départ choisi pour un projet motivant peut être enrichissant, surtout avec des habitudes et des amitiés sur place. On n'est pas forcément plus heureux près de sa famille lorsque les relations sont difficiles.
dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.english: When you live near your family, you drop in for coffee without arranging a time. At a distance, conversations become more planned, especially with a time difference. You share news, but fewer everyday moments.
eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.french: Près des siens, on passe prendre un café sans prévoir un rendez-vous. À distance, les échanges deviennent plus organisés, surtout avec le décalage horaire. On raconte les nouvelles, mais on partage moins les moments ordinaires.
eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f9348b750057c7f4e8aa980e37450a1f91f8dcdb.english: However, not all families are a source of support, and some people are better off living apart. Friends, a partner or neighbours can also help with day-to-day life. Being far from one’s family does not, therefore, necessarily mean being alone.
f9348b750057c7f4e8aa980e37450a1f91f8dcdb.french: Cependant, toutes les familles ne sont pas une source de soutien, et certaines personnes vivent mieux à distance. Des amis, un conjoint ou des voisins peuvent aussi aider au quotidien. Être loin de sa famille ne signifie donc pas forcément être seul.

fc28355a27d5ece851ba6f44e4691337d03fd37b.english: Phone calls keep the bond alive, but they do not always replace being there in person. You can talk regularly and still miss those spontaneous moments shared over a meal.
fc28355a27d5ece851ba6f44e4691337d03fd37b.french: Les appels entretiennent le lien, mais ne remplacent pas toujours une présence physique. On peut parler régulièrement et regretter malgré tout les moments spontanés autour d'un repas.

176b16489cbd5cdffd1dca498206d8af360f502f.english: Money can thus make the reward take precedence over the need to understand and correct one’s mistakes.
176b16489cbd5cdffd1dca498206d8af360f502f.french: L'argent peut ainsi faire passer la récompense avant le besoin de comprendre et de corriger ses erreurs.

1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.english: Her brother may become discouraged at precisely the moment when he needs recognition.
1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.french: Son frère peut se décourager précisément au moment où il aurait besoin de reconnaissance.
1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

21082eff6dddf0d6974f6998c6e73352f11b322d.english: If the mark is the only thing that counts when it comes to rewards, the child may neglect the exercises that help them understand. Their effort then risks being driven by what they stand to gain, rather than by a desire to learn.
21082eff6dddf0d6974f6998c6e73352f11b322d.french: Si seule la note compte pour la récompense, l'enfant peut délaisser les exercices qui l'aident à comprendre. Son effort risque alors de dépendre de ce qu'il pourra gagner, plutôt que de l'envie d'apprendre.

214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.english: I understand a parent's wish to encourage their child, but paying for good marks is not a good foundation. Money can motivate in the short term without creating a lasting desire to learn. I prefer to recognise effort and help the child understand their progress.
214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais payer les bonnes notes n'est pas une bonne base. L'argent peut motiver à court terme sans créer une envie durable d'apprendre. Je préfère reconnaître les efforts et aider l'enfant à comprendre ses progrès.
214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

251d7f92e003413c333d3b5b1ac109d7b40c418c.english: A child adds two numbers when they should be comparing them. The parent asks them to rephrase the instruction and spots the confusion. With the teacher’s help, the child learns to identify the larger number and can try the exercise again.
251d7f92e003413c333d3b5b1ac109d7b40c418c.french: Un enfant additionne deux nombres alors qu'il faut les comparer. Le parent lui demande de reformuler la consigne et repère la confusion. Avec l'enseignant, l'enfant apprend à chercher le plus grand nombre et peut refaire l'exercice.

2b1771e2fc801e364ed9c352b80a9f6d8be0d34b.english: Furthermore, a final mark does not reflect the full extent of the work done.
2b1771e2fc801e364ed9c352b80a9f6d8be0d34b.french: Ensuite, une note finale ne montre pas tout le travail accompli.

2bada2290c8ccc72dca3b8c566d0ad02fbee4d14.english: First and foremost, the child may end up working mainly for the reward.
2bada2290c8ccc72dca3b8c566d0ad02fbee4d14.french: Tout d'abord, l'enfant peut finir par travailler surtout pour la récompense.

33f8a08768870ffc4bba795ce1e906534f9bd8d9.english: The child may think mainly about what they will earn rather than what they have understood. Their motivation may then depend on payment. Activities without a reward may seem less important to them, even when they offer a chance to learn.
33f8a08768870ffc4bba795ce1e906534f9bd8d9.french: L'enfant peut surtout penser à ce qu'il gagnera, plutôt qu'à ce qu'il a compris. La motivation risque alors de dépendre du paiement. Les activités sans récompense peuvent lui sembler moins importantes, même lorsqu'elles permettent d'apprendre.
33f8a08768870ffc4bba795ce1e906534f9bd8d9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4f9fc46dae7de74cc96214933859a5d6d3d428b6.english: Some pupils understand quickly; others work hard to reach a reasonable level. If only a high mark counts, the latter's efforts remain invisible. It is better to look at their starting point and the progress they have made.
4f9fc46dae7de74cc96214933859a5d6d3d428b6.french: Certains élèves comprennent vite ; d'autres travaillent beaucoup pour atteindre un niveau correct. Si seule une note élevée compte, les efforts du second restent invisibles. Il vaut mieux regarder le point de départ et les progrès réalisés.
4f9fc46dae7de74cc96214933859a5d6d3d428b6.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

52d3e09bd2b1dc10616a0617ac905757ad88d9b7.english: Saying "you did well to go back over your mistakes" draws attention to an action they can repeat. Parents can help organise revision and celebrate a milestone without turning every test into a financial negotiation.
52d3e09bd2b1dc10616a0617ac905757ad88d9b7.french: Dire « tu as bien fait de revoir tes erreurs » attire l'attention sur une action reproductible. Les parents peuvent aider à organiser les révisions et célébrer une étape franchie sans transformer chaque contrôle en négociation financière.
52d3e09bd2b1dc10616a0617ac905757ad88d9b7.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

59568d95cbbd8ecbd0070282dc1052186ce1d82c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6a82b124acf6cf8adf10e7d4b71e0c3c9f96c365.english: A girl gets sixteen out of twenty without much revision. Her brother improves from eight to twelve after several weeks of work. If payment starts at fifteen, only she is rewarded.

6ae09783cd8f4d3a330a5bd228477d5dd550a2d1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7e169eb674d746e63b3805c2975abb6f440e8c32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7f48677ce37b8d915d643be67479a36e5b073c80.english: Support is therefore focused on the means of making progress, not just on the result.
7f48677ce37b8d915d643be67479a36e5b073c80.french: Le soutien porte ainsi sur les moyens de progresser, pas seulement sur le résultat.

80a3a6300b234ccba24a9350e4ca7093adb61965.english: A pupil’s mark has gone up from 8 to 12 out of 20 after several weeks of hard work. But his parents only give him money once he reaches 15. He has made real progress, without reaching the threshold that triggers the reward.
80a3a6300b234ccba24a9350e4ca7093adb61965.french: Un élève passe de 8 à 12 sur 20 après plusieurs semaines de travail. Mais ses parents ne donnent de l'argent qu'à partir de 15. Il a fait de vrais progrès, sans atteindre le seuil qui déclenche la récompense.

9185f418b746ea6e2a855deb1d97d827d3a50cc2.english: First, paying for every good mark risks turning school into a financial transaction.
9185f418b746ea6e2a855deb1d97d827d3a50cc2.french: D'abord, payer chaque bonne note risque de transformer l'école en échange financier.

92922f017d9630e38eab84c8361960119efdd3d8.english: Finally, a reward is no substitute for the support needed to overcome a learning block.

93e21f6c80d72741c6536cd47bcef7a51be991f2.english: However, celebrating an achievement or giving an occasional gift is not necessarily a problem. 93e21f6c80d72741c6536cd47bcef7a51be991f2.french: Cependant, célébrer une réussite ou offrir ponctuellement un cadeau n'est pas forcément problématique. 9769c1112aa8c8711b6e244e53a6951d957c0831.english: This approach may therefore mean that real progress goes unrewarded, even though the child has worked hard.
9769c1112aa8c8711b6e244e53a6951d957c0831.french: Ce système peut donc laisser un progrès réel sans récompense, alors que l'enfant a travaillé.

aa74d9994f30c00f1261419aedb6c90cf46119e9.english: A child receives ten euros for a good maths mark. But they refuse to redo the questions they got wrong in the test, because the corrections aren’t marked and won’t earn them any money.
aa74d9994f30c00f1261419aedb6c90cf46119e9.french: Un enfant reçoit dix euros pour sa bonne note de maths. Mais il refuse de refaire les exercices ratés pendant le contrôle, parce que la correction n'est pas notée et ne lui rapportera pas d'argent.

aa81a632d074e8da5ae734be48cad58bbd223355.english: Not all children have the same strengths or face the same difficulties. If we only offer a reward once a certain mark is achieved, we risk overlooking the efforts of a child who is progressing more slowly.
aa81a632d074e8da5ae734be48cad58bbd223355.french: Les enfants n'ont pas tous les mêmes facilités ni les mêmes difficultés. Si l'on paie seulement à partir d'une certaine note, on risque de ne pas remarquer les efforts d'un enfant qui progresse plus lentement.

b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.english: You may get an immediate result without building a habit that continues when you stop paying.
b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.french: On obtient peut-être un résultat immédiat, sans construire une habitude qui continue lorsqu'on ne paie plus.
b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c412a174fe4012027bb94b520fb5a219568455fb.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.english: In short, I prefer to encourage hard work and celebrate progress. The main thing is to help children understand why they are learning and how they can improve.

d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.deepl_english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically rewarding it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically paying for it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.french: En conclusion, on peut fêter une bonne note sans la payer systématiquement. Je préfère reconnaître les progrès, encourager l'envie d'apprendre et aider l'enfant là où il en a besoin.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.review_note: The source distinguishes celebrating a mark from paying money, not from all forms of rewarding it.

da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.english: When a child does not understand an instruction or a method, increasing the reward does not show them how to proceed. We must first identify the difficulty and offer appropriate support.
da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.french: Quand l'enfant ne comprend pas une consigne ou une méthode, augmenter la récompense ne lui montre pas comment procéder. Il faut d'abord repérer la difficulté et proposer un appui adapté.

e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.english: I understand that a parent might want to encourage their child, but I wouldn’t give money for every good mark. e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais je ne donnerais pas d'argent pour chaque bonne note. Cela risque de faire passer la récompense avant l'apprentissage et de ne pas reconnaître tous les efforts. Surtout, l'argent ne remplace pas l'aide dont un enfant peut avoir besoin.

eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.english: The child understands what helped them improve and can feel proud of it, regardless of any sum of money.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.french: L'enfant comprend ce qui l'a fait progresser et peut en être fier, indépendamment d'une somme d'argent.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

01cce6f61d4b0896b5bbb1a56e31d9cb29784a33.english: Their shared experience makes working together useful, beyond the trust that comes from being family.
01cce6f61d4b0896b5bbb1a56e31d9cb29784a33.french: Leur expérience commune rend la collaboration utile, au-delà de la confiance liée à la famille.
01cce6f61d4b0896b5bbb1a56e31d9cb29784a33.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

105083f4ac5778a93c9db5b24c152b38b03406aa.english: A brother and his sister work together. At a family meal, he criticises her for a late delivery. Their mother takes his side. The sister feels judged by her family for a professional mistake, and relations become strained.
105083f4ac5778a93c9db5b24c152b38b03406aa.french: Un frère et sa sœur travaillent ensemble. Au repas familial, il lui reproche une livraison en retard. Leur mère prend parti pour lui. La sœur se sent jugée par sa famille pour une erreur professionnelle, et les relations se tendent.

1367c29970b3b350cf04400cb31c3a783b3b68e7.english: I don’t think you should always avoid working with a family member. It can work well, but family ties are no substitute for skills. You also need to know how to divide up responsibilities and protect the personal relationship.
1367c29970b3b350cf04400cb31c3a783b3b68e7.french: Je ne pense pas qu'il faille toujours éviter de travailler avec un membre de sa famille. 143e7ec0238fc37b63a57f38ac491c76a7a1ccd6.english: A shopkeeper hires his cousin for twenty hours a week. They set out his duties, working hours and pay in writing. If an extra Saturday is needed, they discuss it rather than assuming he must agree to work for free simply because they are family.
143e7ec0238fc37b63a57f38ac491c76a7a1ccd6.french: Un commerçant engage son cousin pour vingt heures par semaine. Ils fixent par écrit ses missions, ses horaires et sa rémunération. Si un samedi supplémentaire est nécessaire, ils en discutent au lieu de supposer qu'il doit accepter gratuitement parce qu'ils sont de la même famille.

21f66a3e4feaef62a8d47f16f2a60440bbc8e216.english: Two sisters open a bakery: one is a baker, the other has managed a shop. They have already sold together at markets and know how each reacts when there are lots of customers.
21f66a3e4feaef62a8d47f16f2a60440bbc8e216.french: Deux sœurs ouvrent une boulangerie : l'une est boulangère, l'autre a géré un magasin. Elles ont déjà vendu ensemble sur les marchés et savent comment chacune réagit face à beaucoup de clients.
21f66a3e4feaef62a8d47f16f2a60440bbc8e216.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

37c9fbeb1029ca79f325bf7125f403d17833ef13.english: This way, the cousin knows exactly what he has agreed to, without having to be available at all hours.

39e92bf22905df1bd6b7eeeb71408e521d074a0d.english: However, rules cannot fix a relationship characterised by pressure or persistent conflicts. 39e92bf22905df1bd6b7eeeb71408e521d074a0d.french: Cependant, des règles ne réparent pas une relation marquée par la pression ou des conflits persistants. Refuser la collaboration peut être le meilleur choix, sans que cela signifie rejeter sa famille. Chacun doit pouvoir dire non et envisager d'autres collaborateurs.

44a8c7cfb19c6d5161f404827d2eb11d4305ab12.english: A conflict does not necessarily remain confined to the workplace when you subsequently find yourself with relatives. Other family members may even be drawn into a problem that does not concern them.
44a8c7cfb19c6d5161f404827d2eb11d4305ab12.french: Un conflit ne reste pas forcément limité au lieu de travail quand on se retrouve ensuite chez des proches. Les autres membres de la famille peuvent même être entraînés dans un problème qui ne les concerne pas.

467fb245b0eed8cfc7a053c60a25cb87cbbb94f7.english: When starting a small business, you need to make quick decisions and be able to rely on someone. Knowing their strengths and limitations helps you divide up roles. But you must choose them for their skills, not just because they are family.
467fb245b0eed8cfc7a053c60a25cb87cbbb94f7.french: Au démarrage d'une petite entreprise, il faut décider vite et pouvoir compter sur quelqu'un. Connaître ses qualités et ses limites aide à répartir les rôles. Mais on doit le choisir pour ses compétences, pas seulement pour son lien familial.
467fb245b0eed8cfc7a053c60a25cb87cbbb94f7.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4ffd3502c063ac7449f6eb48811e721b7a1dd0c7.english: If the manager's son wants to become a team leader, he must have the required skills. Appointing him simply because he is the manager's son would be unfair to a more experienced employee.
4ffd3502c063ac7449f6eb48811e721b7a1dd0c7.french: Si le fils du responsable veut devenir chef d'équipe, il doit avoir les compétences attendues. Le nommer simplement parce qu'il est son fils serait injuste pour un salarié plus expérimenté.
4ffd3502c063ac7449f6eb48811e721b7a1dd0c7.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

53dba948fa0d40577e90810d32673545314e0978.english: Keeping the settings and times separate helps resolve the problem without drawing the family into the conflict.
53dba948fa0d40577e90810d32673545314e0978.french: Séparer les lieux et les moments aide à résoudre le problème sans entraîner la famille dans le conflit.
53dba948fa0d40577e90810d32673545314e0978.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

746ca68bc12327f1157dc110908e1b89b5e102c0.english: In conclusion, it is possible to work with family members if there is trust and the necessary skills. However, clear rules and the ability to say no are essential to preserve the personal relationship as well.
746ca68bc12327f1157dc110908e1b89b5e102c0.french: En conclusion, on peut travailler en famille si la confiance et les compétences sont là. Mais il faut des règles claires et la possibilité de dire non, pour préserver aussi la relation personnelle.

8d4a6584eae68c533650281af0791fe9dc6056ff.english: Criticism may be heard as a personal attack. Conversely, keeping quiet to protect the relationship lets problems build up. You need to set aside times to discuss work, then stop that discussion when you get together as a family.
8d4a6584eae68c533650281af0791fe9dc6056ff.french: Une critique peut être entendue comme une attaque personnelle. À l'inverse, se taire pour préserver la relation laisse les problèmes s'accumuler. 8d4a6584eae68c533650281af0791fe9dc6056ff.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8e4fb4a783aa6996188c01bf05e2fdd5b1425258.english: Next, a professional disagreement can turn into a family conflict.
8e4fb4a783aa6996188c01bf05e2fdd5b1425258.french: Ensuite, un désaccord professionnel peut devenir un conflit familial.
8e4fb4a783aa6996188c01bf05e2fdd5b1425258.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9447308aebb3b573d02b0ee33bb2cb98087f8c12.english: If the relationship is already strained or no one dares say no, it is better to avoid working together. 9447308aebb3b573d02b0ee33bb2cb98087f8c12.french: Si la relation est déjà tendue ou si personne n'ose dire non, mieux vaut éviter cette collaboration. On peut beaucoup s'aimer et avoir des façons de travailler incompatibles : un bon lien familial ne garantit pas une bonne association.
9447308aebb3b573d02b0ee33bb2cb98087f8c12.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

99ee5dc973aade0c9a063ec5060cde6dfc75d2a6.english: Furthermore, professional disagreements can spill over into family life.
99ee5dc973aade0c9a063ec5060cde6dfc75d2a6.french: Ensuite, les désaccords professionnels peuvent déborder sur la vie familiale.

9b63257833aa02d5410a2a9411badbf4d2902c15.english: These criteria protect the team and allow the relative to be recognised for their work, not their name.
9b63257833aa02d5410a2a9411badbf4d2902c15.french: Ces critères protègent l'équipe et permettent au proche d'être reconnu pour son travail, pas pour son nom.
9b63257833aa02d5410a2a9411badbf4d2902c15.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a13c3b408c601c6eef644115d99e6b4d4fc6dd7c.english: Other employees must know that working hours, pay and promotions are based on professional criteria. Otherwise, they may lose trust in management. Written responsibilities and shared rules reduce this risk.

a13c3b408c601c6eef644115d99e6b4d4fc6dd7c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a4bf2aa227b31f8827d1ec29460e9624470fddce.english: You need to know who makes the decisions, how the work is paid for and how to discuss any mistakes. Even amongst close relatives, a clear agreement prevents you from relying on favours that the other person has never agreed to.
a4bf2aa227b31f8827d1ec29460e9624470fddce.french: Il faut savoir qui décide, comment le travail est payé et comment discuter d'une erreur. Même entre proches, un accord clair évite de compter sur des services que l'autre n'a jamais acceptés.

a644d4b580021780b1b9ae0797ff0a9e879d5841.english: Finally, being related must not bring unjustified privileges.
a644d4b580021780b1b9ae0797ff0a9e879d5841.french: Enfin, la parenté ne doit pas donner de privilèges injustifiés.
a644d4b580021780b1b9ae0797ff0a9e879d5841.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a6796383b785a66ad0c33dce23b6146b6c728186.english: First and foremost, trust that has already been established can make it easier to get a project off the ground.
a6796383b785a66ad0c33dce23b6146b6c728186.french: Tout d'abord, une confiance déjà construite peut faciliter le lancement d'un projet.

b193f7bcd5319d2d55c24426eef12c9cdf52a97c.english: First, knowing how a relative works can be an advantage.
b193f7bcd5319d2d55c24426eef12c9cdf52a97c.french: D'abord, connaître la manière de travailler d'un proche peut être un avantage.

b7dd0ac16a4a47a3439f68d49e875866b76be815.french: Deux sœurs qui ont déjà organisé ensemble des événements peuvent créer une activité de restauration. c1d4a56241d1c016d83d3b1a4167af1916d5a0e6.english: Trust therefore helps us to work together when we truly understand each other’s capabilities.
c1d4a56241d1c016d83d3b1a4167af1916d5a0e6.french: La confiance aide donc à travailler ensemble lorsqu'on connaît réellement les capacités de l'autre.

c867dfcfe7dada0d5a79631d14923d5bad9826c7.english: Conflict therefore no longer affects just colleagues: it also damages family relationships.
c867dfcfe7dada0d5a79631d14923d5bad9826c7.french: Le conflit ne touche donc plus seulement les collègues : il abîme aussi les relations familiales.

c8d3e2abad013a327b8ccf21a5490671dcfb6b2e.english: I do not think we should always avoid working with family. Established trust and complementary skills can help. But conflicts that spill over into private life and the risk of favouritism must be taken seriously.
c8d3e2abad013a327b8ccf21a5490671dcfb6b2e.french: Je ne pense pas qu'il faille éviter systématiquement de travailler en famille. c8d3e2abad013a327b8ccf21a5490671dcfb6b2e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

cd128bf39d20441c6994e730de2c9659134aa4ad.english: When you know how a family member works, you can discuss commitments and boundaries more directly. This advantage exists if their skills match the project, not simply because you share the same surname.
cd128bf39d20441c6994e730de2c9659134aa4ad.french: Quand on connaît la manière de travailler d'un proche, on peut discuter plus directement des engagements et des limites. Cet avantage existe si les compétences correspondent au projet, pas simplement parce qu'on porte le même nom.

d69fa66cbbe6421c032aef0cebb93a626d39cd9d.english: A brother often arrives late at the restaurant he runs with his sister. She can raise this with him in a meeting, rather than in front of all their relatives at Sunday lunch.
d69fa66cbbe6421c032aef0cebb93a626d39cd9d.french: Un frère arrive souvent en retard au restaurant qu'il gère avec sa sœur. Elle peut lui en parler en réunion, plutôt que devant tous les proches au repas du dimanche.
d69fa66cbbe6421c032aef0cebb93a626d39cd9d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ec72d8f13aeacfcc34bcff9e1764a20cc91fb05c.english: A sister delivers an order late and her brother reproaches her for it during a family meal. Their mother takes his side. The sister feels judged by her family for a professional mistake, and relations become strained.
ec72d8f13aeacfcc34bcff9e1764a20cc91fb05c.french: Une sœur livre une commande en retard et son frère lui en fait le reproche au repas familial. Leur mère prend parti pour lui. La sœur se sent jugée par sa famille pour une erreur professionnelle, et les relations se tendent.

f71e90aea2d7769d9e2684b81d163e0a7690aebe.english: Finally, clear rules help to avoid misunderstandings about work and money.
f71e90aea2d7769d9e2684b81d163e0a7690aebe.french: Enfin, des règles claires aident à éviter les malentendus sur le travail et l'argent.

fafad48d939eb82457f88dd7d243cb6b51d09e00.english: So working with family can succeed with skilled people and clear roles. Otherwise, choosing another partner may protect the relationship.
fafad48d939eb82457f88dd7d243cb6b51d09e00.french: Donc, travailler en famille peut fonctionner avec des personnes compétentes et des rôles clairs. Sinon, choisir un autre partenaire peut préserver la relation.
fafad48d939eb82457f88dd7d243cb6b51d09e00.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

01ed459dfdc29280cda582d2a0a90e58136a6cbb.english: A relationship built on trust allows us to hear a different point of view and try an activity we might not have chosen on our own. This openness can enrich our lives without us having to follow every piece of advice.
01ed459dfdc29280cda582d2a0a90e58136a6cbb.french: Une relation de confiance permet de recevoir un avis différent et d'essayer une activité que l'on n'aurait pas choisie seul. Cette ouverture peut enrichir notre vie sans qu'on soit obligé de suivre tous les conseils.

1230741bcebfbeefb53d496a0a1305e262fe40ed.english: In conclusion, friends can make life easier, help us feel less lonely and encourage us to push ourselves. They offer a great deal, without being essential to everyone: other relationships can also enable us to live well.
1230741bcebfbeefb53d496a0a1305e262fe40ed.french: En conclusion, les amis peuvent faciliter la vie, aider à se sentir moins seul et nous encourager à nous dépasser. Ils apportent beaucoup, sans être indispensables à chacun : d'autres relations peuvent aussi nous permettre de bien vivre.

1f4c665ad806789bc12e525817e12477a403c334.english: Someone who is ill needs to go to a follow-up appointment at the hospital. A friend comes to collect them, accompanies them to the relevant department and takes them back home.

214aad8c58d167e506415b0021c642fe1c533033.french: L'encouragement permet de développer une capacité qu'il aurait peut-être laissée de côté.

2ae4046d5a6641fce5bc4ede2db9e21d74c67186.english: A friend who understands our situation can offer tailored advice or take over a task. We don’t have to organise everything on our own, even if their help is voluntary and depends on what they’re able to do.

32453b2f9e65ba34694251aaa6fa8ee80095b693.english: Being able to meet up regularly allows us to share our daily lives. Knowing that a friend is checking in on us can help us feel less lonely, especially when we don’t see many people.
32453b2f9e65ba34694251aaa6fa8ee80095b693.french: Pouvoir se retrouver régulièrement permet de partager son quotidien. Savoir qu'un ami prend de nos nouvelles peut aider à se sentir moins seul, surtout quand on voit peu de monde.

328b9c20b116410ccf1d5cd07ac4f42fb13e85c8.english: This encouragement can thus help us to carry out a project, rather than giving up on it due to a lack of confidence.
328b9c20b116410ccf1d5cd07ac4f42fb13e85c8.french: Cet encouragement peut ainsi nous aider à réaliser un projet, plutôt qu'à y renoncer par manque de confiance.

3f238958b34850e1c2c2d3f61f838b9941394a83.deepl_english: This get-together can therefore help you feel less lonely and provide a regular highlight in your week.

3f27143a9c863b9854884699cbfd7ee5b29e8b4c.deepl_english: Someone who lives alone and works from home may go several days without seeing anyone. A friend suggests they go for a walk every Saturday. She leaves the house, talks about her week and knows they’ll meet up again the following week.

3f27143a9c863b9854884699cbfd7ee5b29e8b4c.french: Une personne qui vit seule et travaille chez elle peut passer plusieurs jours sans voir personne. Un ami lui propose une promenade chaque samedi. Elle sort de chez elle, raconte sa semaine et sait qu'ils se retrouveront la semaine suivante.

6818244c7dd8a2712f982da59365d3abb93d8bdf.english: That said, an acquaintance does not always replace a confidant. If you want to talk more freely, some relationships are worth deepening. Friendship is also reciprocal: you cannot demand constant availability.
6818244c7dd8a2712f982da59365d3abb93d8bdf.french: Cela dit, une connaissance ne remplace pas toujours un confident. Si l'on souhaite parler plus librement, certains liens méritent d'être approfondis. Une amitié reste aussi réciproque : on ne peut pas exiger une disponibilité permanente.
6818244c7dd8a2712f982da59365d3abb93d8bdf.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6c82ee32e14cf80cd469ebe17e5bcd3d1cd9a6eb.english: Their jobs and hobbies differ from ours. They can introduce us to an activity and give us the confidence to try, then continue despite our doubts. Friendship can thus support a personal project without making the decision for us.

80201f4b40cf5b19e121f628e23d3a5958b032c8.english: Finally, friends can encourage us to push ourselves.
80201f4b40cf5b19e121f628e23d3a5958b032c8.french: Enfin, les amis peuvent nous encourager à nous dépasser.

8961f1ce17086f6daf488a24439fed43c81efd39.english: Being independent does not mean you never face something unexpected. Family do not always live nearby and paid services are not always accessible. Being able to rely on a friend, and return the favour, helps you get through these times.

8961f1ce17086f6daf488a24439fed43c81efd39.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9246fd79b4d2f28709ac9ad245560c12418d7ffe.english: First and foremost, a trusted friend can provide practical help with day-to-day life.

9ab515052fedebd3f09c1e65a28e8cbcb93e68f4.english: First and foremost, a trusted friend can offer practical help when you’re struggling to cope on your own.
9ab515052fedebd3f09c1e65a28e8cbcb93e68f4.french: Tout d'abord, un ami de confiance peut apporter une aide concrète quand on a du mal à tout gérer seul.

9b827bf08ca857a0001636fe0318745d45f43b7d.english: I recommend nurturing friendships, but it is also possible to live well without friends. Needs and other relationships vary. Above all, friendship provides practical support, a regular presence and an openness to new experiences.
